jobs.title: Host Live Streaming / Live Commerce
jobs.description: Melakukan live streaming untuk mempromosikan dan menjual produk beauty seperti Press On Nails, Eyelash Cluster, beauty accessories, dan produk Nau Nau Beauty lainnya. Menjelaskan detail produk, harga, promo, cara penggunaan, serta keunggulan produk dengan jelas dan menarik. Aktif berinteraksi dengan viewers, menjawab pertanyaan, dan membangun suasana live yang seru. Melakukan demo produk saat live jika diperlukan. Mendorong penjualan dan membantu mencapai target selama live streaming. Mempelajari product knowledge serta promo yang sedang berjalan sebelum live. Menjaga penampilan, attitude, dan komunikasi selama live. Bekerja sama dengan tim untuk evaluasi dan meningkatkan performa live. Kualifikasi: Perempuan usia 18–28 tahun. Percaya diri berbicara di depan kamera. Komunikatif, ceria, ekspresif, dan tidak kaku saat live. Tidak malu melakukan demo produk. Cepat belajar dan mampu menghafal informasi produk. Mampu membangun interaksi dengan penonton. Memiliki kemampuan selling dan berorientasi pada target penjualan. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Aktif menggunakan TikTok dan familiar dengan TikTok Shop. Pengalaman sebagai Host Live menjadi nilai tambah, namun fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memiliki ketertarikan pada dunia beauty menjadi nilai tambah. Berdomisili di Makassar/Gowa lebih diutamakan

jobs.title: Barback
jobs.description: CHAKANA SEMINYAK We're Hiring | Barback Join Our Opening Team in Bali - A New Rum Bar in Bali We're looking for a dedicated and motivated Barback to join our opening team at an exciting new premium rum bar in Bali. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about hospitality, enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, and is eager to build a career in bartending. What We're Looking For Ability to work quickly and anticipate operational needs (mise en place, ice, garnishes, and stock replenishment). Basic knowledge of bartending techniques and terminology, with a strong desire to develop into a bartender. Rigor in keeping the station tidy and clean Ability to support bartenders efficiently during busy service periods Motivation to grow into a bartender role — a good indicator of engagement Key Responsibilities Prepare and maintain the bar's mise en place before, during, and after service. Restock spirits, mixers, garnishes, glassware, ice, and other bar supplies to ensure smooth operations. Support bartenders by preparing ingredients, polishing glassware, and maintaining cleanliness throughout service. Ensure the bar area, equipment, and storage spaces are clean, organized, and fully stocked. Assist with receiving, storing, and rotating inventory according to company standards. Support the bar team in delivering efficient, high-quality service during busy periods. Learn about the venue's beverage program, particularly rum, cocktails, and wine, while developing bartending knowledge. Contribute to a positive team environment and help create memorable guest experiences. Why Join Us? Be part of an exciting new hospitality concept from its very beginning. Learn from experienced bartenders and develop valuable bar and beverage skills. Grow your career in a supportive, dynamic, and guest-focused environment with opportunities for advancement. CHAKANA SEMINYAK

We're Hiring | Barback

Join Our Opening Team in Bali - A New Rum Bar in Bali
We're looking for a dedicated and motivated Barback to join our opening team at an exciting new premium rum bar in Bali. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about hospitality, enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, and is eager to build a career in bartending.

What We're Looking For

  • Ability to work quickly and anticipate operational needs (mise en place, ice, garnishes, and stock replenishment).

  • Basic knowledge of bartending techniques and terminology, with a strong desire to develop into a bartender.

  • Rigor in keeping the station tidy and clean

  • Ability to support bartenders efficiently during busy service periods

  • Motivation to grow into a bartender role — a good indicator of engagement

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and maintain the bar's mise en place before, during, and after service.

  • Restock spirits, mixers, garnishes, glassware, ice, and other bar supplies to ensure smooth operations.

  • Support bartenders by preparing ingredients, polishing glassware, and maintaining cleanliness throughout service.

  • Ensure the bar area, equipment, and storage spaces are clean, organized, and fully stocked.

  • Assist with receiving, storing, and rotating inventory according to company standards.

  • Support the bar team in delivering efficient, high-quality service during busy periods.

  • Learn about the venue's beverage program, particularly rum, cocktails, and wine, while developing bartending knowledge.

  • Contribute to a positive team environment and help create memorable guest experiences.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of an exciting new hospitality concept from its very beginning.

  • Learn from experienced bartenders and develop valuable bar and beverage skills.

  • Grow your career in a supportive, dynamic, and guest-focused environment with opportunities for advancement.

If you're hardworking, eager to learn, and ready to build a career behind the bar, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of Chakana Seminyak's opening team.

jobs.title: Drafter
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT EVANCEMERLANG ABADI' mencari seorang Drafter yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim Desain & Arsitektur kami di Berau, Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Drafter, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengonversi konsep desain arsitektur menjadi gambar teknis yang akurat dan detail. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkontribusi pada proyek-proyek konstruksi dan infrastruktur yang signifikan, bekerja sama dengan arsitek dan insinyur untuk menghasilkan dokumentasi teknis berkualitas tinggi. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan kontrak , berlokasi di Berau, Kalimantan Timur. Tanggung Jawab Utama Membuat gambar teknis dan denah arsitektur yang detail dan akurat menggunakan perangkat lunak CAD sesuai dengan standar industri dan spesifikasi proyek. Menerjemahkan sketsa desain dan konsep dari arsitek menjadi gambar kerja yang komprehensif dan mudah dipahami oleh tim konstruksi. Memastikan konsistensi dan akurasi dalam semua dokumentasi teknis, termasuk detail konstruksi, penampang, dan elevasi. Berkolaborasi dengan arsitek, insinyur, dan tim proyek lainnya untuk memahami persyaratan desain dan melakukan revisi sesuai kebutuhan. Memperbarui dan memodifikasi gambar teknis berdasarkan feedback dan perubahan desain yang diperlukan selama fase proyek. Menjaga organisasi file dan dokumentasi proyek untuk memudahkan referensi dan audit di masa depan. Mengikuti protokol keselamatan dan standar kualitas dalam semua pekerjaan drafting. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Sertifikat di bidang Drafting Arsitektur, Arsitektur, atau Teknik Sipil. Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Drafter dalam proyek arsitektur atau konstruksi. Mahir menggunakan perangkat lunak CAD, khususnya AutoCAD, dengan kemampuan membuat gambar 2D dan 3D yang presisi. Pemahaman mendalam tentang standar gambar teknis arsitektur, simbol, dan konvensi industri. Kemampuan membaca dan menginterpretasi rencana arsitektur, spesifikasi teknis, dan dokumentasi proyek. Perhatian terhadap detail yang sangat tinggi dan kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan akurasi dalam lingkungan yang memerlukan presisi tinggi. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan keterampilan kerja tim untuk berkolaborasi secara efektif dengan arsitek dan profesional lainnya. Pengetahuan tentang software pendukung seperti Revit atau SketchUp merupakan nilai tambah. Pengalaman dengan proyek-proyek skala besar atau infrastruktur adalah keuntungan tambahan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda. Kesempatan untuk bekerja pada proyek-proyek menarik di sektor desain dan arsitektur yang berkembang. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung dengan tim yang berpengalaman. Peluang pengembangan keterampilan melalui pelatihan dan mentoring dari profesional berpengalaman. Kesempatan untuk meningkatkan portofolio profesional dengan berbagai jenis proyek. Jam kerja yang jelas dan struktur kerja yang teratur untuk menjaga keseimbangan hidup kerja. Tentang Kami PT EVANCEMERLANG ABADI' adalah perusahaan yang berfokus pada layanan desain dan arsitektur berkualitas tinggi. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi desain inovatif dan profesional bagi berbagai proyek konstruksi dan infrastruktur. Dengan tim profesional yang berdedikasi, kami berusaha menciptakan hasil karya yang melampaui ekspektasi klien sambil mempertahankan standar kualitas tertinggi dalam setiap proyek. Perusahaan kami menghargai keahlian, presisi, dan kolaborasi tim dalam mencapai kesuksesan bersama. Ajakan untuk Melamar Jika Anda memiliki keterampilan drafting yang solid dan bersemangat untuk berkontribusi pada proyek-proyek bermakna di bidang arsitektur, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Kirimkan CV, portofolio pekerjaan Anda, dan surat lamaran ke tim rekrutmen kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal lebih lanjut tentang pengalaman dan keahlian Anda.

jobs.title: Associate, Cybersecurity / Information Security
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities: Assist in the review, update, and maintenance of information security policies, procedures, and related documentation. Support policy amendments and periodic reviews to ensure alignment with business requirements, regulatory requirements, and applicable security standards. Assist with vulnerability assessments and security testing, including identifying, documenting, and tracking vulnerabilities through remediation. Support secure configuration reviews of systems, applications, and infrastructure against approved security baselines, hardening guidelines, and industry standards. Assist in assessing compliance with relevant security frameworks, standards, and configuration benchmarks. Support the preparation of security assessment reports, findings, recommendations, and audit evidence. Coordinate with IT and security teams to follow up on identified vulnerabilities, security gaps, and remediation activities. Maintain accurate records of security reviews, assessments, findings, evidence, and remediation status. Stay updated on cybersecurity best practices, security standards, emerging threats, and vulnerabilities. Desired Skill Sets: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline. 0–3 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information security, GRC, vulnerability management, security assessment, or a related field. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), ISO/IEC 27001, CompTIA CySA+, CISA, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications are preferred. Basic understanding of cybersecurity, information security, risk management, and security controls. Familiarity with security policies, procedures, standards, and frameworks. Understanding of vulnerability assessment, security testing, secure configuration, and system hardening. Good analytical, documentation, communication, and coordination skills. Ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Production Engineer (Tetra Pak & SIG)
jobs.description: Summary: Responsible for supporting and improving daily production operations by ensuring efficient production processes, reliable equipment performance, product quality, and compliance with K3, HSE, and food safety standards. The Production Engineer will monitor production performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Hands-on experience with Tetra Pak machines is mandatory , while experience with SIG machines is a strong advantage . Responsibilities: Monitor daily production activities to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Ensure production targets, process parameters, and SOPs are properly followed. Troubleshoot production and equipment-related issues and coordinate with Maintenance and Technicians for resolution. Monitor and improve the performance and reliability of production equipment. Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and support production processes involving Tetra Pak machines. Support equipment calibration, process monitoring, and technical inspections. Analyze production data and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce waste. Lead or support Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and continuous improvement projects . Collaborate with QA to ensure product quality and food safety requirements are consistently maintained. Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for production and quality issues. Identify potential production risks and ensure compliance with K3/HSE and food safety requirements. Maintain accurate production records, technical documentation, and performance reports. Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, QA, and other related departments to resolve operational issues. Support new equipment installation, process modification, and production improvement projects. Requirements: Education Background Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Food Technology, or related fields. Candidates from other relevant majors may be considered with sufficient manufacturing experience. Experience & Knowledge Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a Production Engineer, Process Engineer, or similar role in a manufacturing environment. Mandatory: Hands-on experience with Tetra Pak machines , particularly in production/process operations and troubleshooting. Experience with SIG machines is a strong advantage. Experience in the food, dairy, beverage, or FMCG industry is preferred. Good knowledge of production processes, machinery, and industrial equipment. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies . Able to read and understand technical drawings, machine manuals, and technical instructions. Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel , for production data analysis and reporting. Good understanding of GMP, food safety, K3/HSE, and production quality requirements . Willing to work in shifts and support production operations when required. Willing and able to undergo the company-required Medical Check-Up (MCU) at the designated company partner hospital as part of the recruitment process.

Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future roles. Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on hiring progress. Continuously improve sourcing strategies and recruitment processes. About you Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Management, or a related field. Minimum 2–3 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience. Experience recruiting for both office and operational roles is preferred. Strong sourcing and candidate assessment skills. Familiarity with LinkedIn, Glints, Pintarnya, Jobstreet and other major recruitment platforms. Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple vacancies. Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia. We are committed to enhancing consumer lives through high-quality products, services, and brands that connect deeply with their audiences.

jobs.title: INCOME AUDITOR & ACCOUNT RECEIVABLE
jobs.description: INCOME AUDITOR & ACCOUNT RECEIVABLE Finance - Baobab Safari Resort Reports To: Chief Accountant Job Summary Responsible for performing daily income audit and managing accounts receivable activities to ensure all hotel revenue and receivable transactions are accurate, complete, properly recorded, and collected on time. Key Responsibilities Income Audit Audit and verify daily hotel revenue from Rooms, F&B, Spa, Recreation, Events, and other revenue outlets. Reconcile revenue reports from PMS, POS, cashier reports, credit cards, bank transfers, and other payment methods. Verify discounts, rebates, voids, complimentary transactions, and adjustments. Identify and investigate revenue discrepancies and ensure proper corrections. Prepare daily Income Audit and Revenue Reconciliation Reports. Ensure compliance with hotel financial policies and internal controls. Account Receivable Manage daily Accounts Receivable (AR) transactions and customer outstanding balances. Prepare and verify invoices and supporting billing documents. Monitor receivables from Corporate Accounts, Travel Agents, OTA, Events, and other credit customers. Follow up outstanding payments according to agreed credit terms. Prepare AR Aging Reports and collection monitoring reports. Reconcile customer accounts and investigate billing discrepancies. Record and reconcile incoming payments accurately. Coordinate with Sales, Front Office, F&B, and other departments regarding billing and collection issues. Maintain complete and accurate AR documentation. Assist with month-end closing and account reconciliation. Requirements Minimum Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel accounting, preferably with experience in Income Audit and/or Account Receivable. Proficient in VHP (Visual Hotel Program) and able to perform hotel accounting-related transactions using the system. Good understanding of hotel revenue, accounts receivable, and accounting principles. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and familiar with hotel PMS, POS, and accounting systems. Strong analytical, numerical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented, accurate, honest, and well-organized. Good communication and coordination skills. Able to manage multiple responsibilities and work under deadlines.

  • Good communication and coordination skills.

jobs.title: Human Resources Analyst
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for an HR professional to manage our people operations and help build strong, scalable HR processes across the organization. Key responsibilities Manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee records, attendance, leave, onboarding, and offboarding. Draft and maintain employment contracts, HR documentation, policies, and SOPs. Ensure compliance with Indonesian labor regulations, BPJS Kesehatan, and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Manage employee insurance, benefits administration, and related external providers. Handle employee relations and support management on workplace and disciplinary matters. Support performance reviews, employee development, and other people initiatives. Assist with recruitment and hiring activities when required. Continuously improve HR processes as the organization grows. About you Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Law, Management, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of HR experience, preferably in an HR Generalist or HR Operations role. Good understanding of Indonesian labor regulations, BPJS, and employment practices. Experience with employment contracts, HR policies, SOPs, and employee relations. Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently. High level of integrity when handling confidential information. Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia. About us Skavana is a consumer-focused group that builds and invests in brands across industries that shape meaningful experiences. We are committed to enhancing consumer lives through high-quality products, services, and brands that connect deeply with their audiences.

jobs.title: Administrasi project
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari seorang Administrasi Project yang terorganisir dan detail-oriented untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Tropikal Bali. Sebagai Administrasi Project, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional berbagai proyek dengan mengelola dokumentasi, jadwal, dan komunikasi administratif. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang proaktif, terampil dalam manajemen waktu, dan mampu bekerja efektif dalam lingkungan yang dinamis. Jabatan ini adalah posisi fulltime berbasis di South Denpasar, Bali, tempat Anda akan berkolaborasi langsung dengan tim project dan stakeholder internal untuk memastikan semua kebutuhan administratif terpenuhi dengan sempurna. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola dokumentasi project, termasuk pembuatan, penyimpanan, dan pembaruan file, proposal, dan laporan penting secara sistematis. Mengkoordinasikan jadwal meeting, appointment, dan timeline project untuk memastikan semua pihak terkait terinformasi dengan baik. Memproses dan mengorganisir data administratif, serta memastikan keakuratan informasi dalam sistem database perusahaan. Melakukan komunikasi administratif dengan klien, vendor, dan tim internal melalui email, telepon, dan platform komunikasi lainnya. Menyiapkan dan mengarsipkan dokumen project, kontrak, dan surat-surat penting sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Mendukung tim project dalam persiapan presentasi dan materi meeting yang diperlukan. Mencatat dan melaporkan progress project serta menyelesaikan tugas administratif dengan akurasi tinggi dan tepat waktu. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal Diploma (D3) atau setara dalam bidang Administrasi, Manajemen, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang administrasi, dukungan office, atau project support. Penguasaan Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan keahlian dalam menggunakan software administrasi atau project management tools. Kemampuan komunikasi tertulis dan lisan yang sangat baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris. Keterampilan organisasi yang kuat dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dan akurasi data. Kemampuan mengelola multiple tasks secara bersamaan dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan prioritas yang berubah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda. Cuti tahunan yang fleksibel dan hari libur sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan. Kesempatan pengembangan karier melalui program pelatihan dan workshop internal. Lingkungan kerja yang modern, mendukung, dan kolaboratif. Tunjangan transportasi dan keseimbangan work-life balance yang baik. Peluang untuk berkembang profesional bersama tim yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi. Tentang Kami Tropikal Bali adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan dan produk berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami. Dengan lokasi strategis di South Denpasar, Bali, kami telah membangun reputasi yang solid dalam industri kami. Perusahaan kami menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai integritas, inovasi, dan customer excellence. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki kontribusi penting terhadap kesuksesan bersama, dan kami menciptakan budaya kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan profesional, kolaborasi antar tim, dan inklusi. Bergabunglah dengan kami untuk menjadi bagian dari organisasi yang dinamis dan forward-thinking yang terus berkembang dan berinovasi. Lamar Sekarang Apakah Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini? Kami ingin mendengar dari Anda! Silakan kirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portfolio relevan Anda melalui portal karir kami atau email ke tim Human Resources kami. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan untuk bergabung dengan Tropikal Bali dan menjadi bagian dari tim yang luar biasa!

jobs.title: Fire Safety Officer
jobs.description: The Fire Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring effective fire prevention, protection, and emergency preparedness across the facility. This role focuses on maintaining fire safety systems and equipment, conducting fire risk assessments and emergency drills, providing fire safety training, and ensuring compliance with K3 and applicable fire safety regulations. The position also supports incident investigation, safety inspections, and continuous improvement to maintain a safe and emergency-ready working environment. Job Description Ensure implementation and compliance of fire safety policies, procedures, and applicable K3 regulations . Conduct Fire Risk Assessments and identify potential fire hazards across production, warehouse, utility, and office areas. Inspect and monitor fire alarm, detection, firefighting, and emergency response systems to ensure proper functionality and readiness. Coordinate preventive maintenance, testing, and inspection of fire protection equipment, including hydrants, sprinklers, fire pumps, extinguishers, and fire alarms. Develop and conduct emergency response, fire, and evacuation drills , including evaluation and corrective action follow-up. Provide fire safety training and emergency response awareness to employees, contractors, and emergency response teams. Monitor hot work, flammable materials, emergency exits, and other fire prevention controls across operational areas. Prepare fire safety reports, maintain inspection records, investigate incidents, and support HSE audits and continuous improvement programs . Complete required Annual Medical Check-Up (MCU) as part of the company's employment safety procedures and Occupational Health. Qualification : Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field . Minimum 2 years of experience as a Safety/HSE Officer , preferably in FMCG, food, dairy, or manufacturing industries . Strong understanding of fire alarm, fire detection, firefighting, and emergency response systems . Experienced in Fire Risk Assessment, emergency response planning, and fire/evacuation drills . AK3 Umum and Fire Fighting/Fire Safety Certificate – Mandatory . Knowledge of Indonesian K3 and fire safety regulations , with ISO 45001 knowledge considered an advantage. Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and emergency decision-making skills , with willingness to work shifts. Proficient in English, both written and spoken, and willing to undergo the company's required MCU as part of the recruitment process. Willing to work daily on a rolling shift system, with working hours subject to operational requirements and tentative scheduling.

About the role

The Superintendent HSE Management System is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving Integrated Management Systems covering ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMKP Minerba, Contractor Safety Management System (CSMS), and Corporate Safety Management Standards across operations and business partners. This role supervises the effective implementation of occupational health and safety programs, controls safety performance measurement, and ensures compliance with regulatory obligations and management system requirements.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement Industrial Hygiene and Occupational Health programs and Safety loss Control programs to prevent occupational illness and injury, ensuring health hazards are identified, evaluated and controlled

  • Control and optimize safety performance measurement through management of leading and lagging indicator data to produce accurate, relevant, and timely analysis for management decision-making

  • Sound understanding of mining regulations, occupational health & safety regulations, environmental regulations, and Good Mining Practice requirements

jobs.title: VILLA SALES, RESERVATION & OPERATIONS OFFICER
jobs.description: Location: Pecatu, Uluwatu - Bali (Preffer to candidates who currently reside within approximately 20–30 minutes of the villa location in Pecatu, Uluwatu.) Employment Type: Full Time Salary: Rp5.000.000/month + Sales Incentive/Commission About the Position: We are looking for a proactive, communicative, and hospitality-oriented Villa Sales, Reservation & Operations Officer to manage daily villa operations while supporting sales, reservations, OTA management, and guest relations. This position is suitable for someone who can work independently, is comfortable communicating with guests, and has a strong understanding of hospitality operations and online booking platforms. Key Responsibilities 1. OTA & Reservation Manage villa listings and reservations through OTA platforms such as Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Expedia, etc. Monitor room availability, rates, promotions, and inventory. Respond to guest inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle booking confirmations, cancellations, modifications, and special requests. Maintain an accurate reservation calendar and prevent double bookings. Follow up with potential guests to convert inquiries into bookings. Prepare daily/weekly reservation reports. 2. Sales & Revenue Generate direct bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram, website, referrals, and other channels. Follow up leads and potential customers. Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, and local partners. Promote villa packages and special offers. Upsell additional services such as airport transfers, breakfast, BBQ, tours, transportation, etc. Achieve agreed monthly occupancy and revenue targets. Monitor competitor rates and market conditions. 3. Guest Relations & Concierge Communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay. Coordinate check-in and check-out arrangements. Assist guests with transportation, restaurant reservations, tours, activities, and other requests. Handle guest complaints professionally and coordinate solutions. Ensure guests receive a positive and personalized experience. Follow up on guest feedback and online reviews. 4. Villa Operations Conduct daily villa readiness and operational checks. Ensure the villa and public areas are clean, presentable, and guest-ready. Coordinate with Housekeeping, Maintenance, Garden, and Pool teams. Monitor amenities, linen, guest supplies, and operational inventory. Report maintenance issues and follow up on completion. Ensure operational standards are maintained. Assist management in implementing SOPs and improving guest experience. 5. Public Area Monitoring Monitor cleanliness and presentation of entrance, pool area, garden, terrace, parking area, and other public areas. Coordinate cleaning and maintenance requirements. Ensure all public areas are safe, clean, and ready for guests. Requirements Minimum education: SMA/SMK/Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel, villa, resort, reservation, sales, or hospitality operations. Experience handling OTA platforms is preferred. Good knowledge of reservation processes and hospitality operations. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic Excel. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Able to coordinate multiple operational tasks. Target-oriented and willing to work with sales targets. Well-groomed, professional, friendly, and service-oriented. Willing to work weekends, public holidays, and according to villa operational requirements. Having a valid driving license and own transportation is an advantage. Key Skills Must Have OTA management Reservation handling Guest communication Basic sales skills English communication Microsoft Office / Google Workspace Problem solving Operational coordination Preferred Booking.com / Agoda / Airbnb experience PMS experience Revenue management knowledge Travel agent/networking experience Social media and digital marketing knowledge Experience in villa operations

jobs.title: HUMAN CAPITAL MANAGER
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Human Capital Manager to lead and strengthen our people strategy while supporting business growth and operational excellence across the organization. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement Human Capital strategies aligned with business objectives and expansion plans. Lead workforce planning initiatives to ensure adequate manpower availability across business units and outlets. Oversee end-to-end Human Capital functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Performance Management, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations, and HR Operations. Drive the implementation of performance management systems, KPI frameworks, talent development, and succession planning initiatives. Ensure payroll, employee administration, benefits, and labor compliance processes are executed accurately and efficiently. Build and strengthen organizational culture through employee engagement and culture development programs. Partner closely with operational leaders to improve workforce productivity, employee capability, and organizational effectiveness. Analyze people metrics and provide strategic recommendations to support management decision-making. Support new branch openings by ensuring manpower readiness, training readiness, and organizational setup. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Management, Law, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Human Resources / Human Capital. Minimum 2 years of experience in a Supervisor or Managerial role. Proven experience managing end-to-end HR functions, including: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Payroll & HR Administration Performance Management Employee Relations & Industrial Relations Learning & Development Strong understanding of manpower planning, organizational development, HR policies, and labor regulations. Experience in hospitality, retail, wellness, F&B chain, or service-based businesses is highly preferred. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate HR insights into business actions. Why Join Us? Opportunity to lead Human Capital transformation in a rapidly growing organization. Direct involvement in shaping organizational culture and people strategy. Dynamic and collaborative work environment. Significant exposure to business expansion and organizational development projects. Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

jobs.description: Baker Shop Qualifications Minimum Senior High School/Vocational High School (SMA/SMK) in Culinary, Bakery, or Hospitality, or equivalent. Minimum 1 year of experience in bakery, pastry, café, or retail operations; experience in a customer-facing role is preferred. Good knowledge of bakery production, including dough preparation, baking techniques, product handling, and basic food presentation. Able to maintain product quality, freshness, consistency, and proper food storage. Familiar with food safety, hygiene, sanitation principles. Able to operate POS/cashier systems and handle cash and non-cash transactions accurately. Able to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, including bakery production and customer service. Detail-oriented, responsible, honest, and able to maintain cleanliness and organization of the work area. Able to work independently as well as part of a team. Willing to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Key responsibilities Develop and lead Sensatia's marketing strategy, annual marketing plan and campaign calendar in line with company growth objectives and brand direction. Lead integrated marketing planning and execution across brand communications, retail marketing, product launches, events, partnerships and other customer-facing initiatives. Develop, own and manage the Marketing budget within the overall Commercial plan, ensuring disciplined allocation of resources and measurable commercial and brand outcomes. Strengthen Sensatia's brand positioning and ensure consistent brand expression across all customer touchpoints. Translate company and commercial objectives into clear marketing priorities, campaigns and execution plans. Work closely with Digital Marketing, Creative, E-Commerce, Sales, Retail Operations and Visual Merchandising to deliver coordinated commercial initiatives. Establish clear objectives and KPIs for marketing activities, evaluate performance and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and ROI. Use customer, market, competitive and commercial insights to identify opportunities and inform marketing decisions. Lead, coach and develop the Marketing team, creating clear accountability and building stronger marketing capabilities. About you Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience leading and developing a team. Strong consumer-brand marketing experience; beauty, skincare, personal care, FMCG, lifestyle, retail or premium consumer-brand experience is preferred. Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer marketing and commercial marketing. Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns and managing meaningful marketing budgets. Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into strong execution and measurable outcomes. Commercially minded and comfortable using data, customer insights, KPIs and ROI to evaluate marketing performance. Strong leadership, strategic thinking, communication and project-management capabilities. Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Based in Bali or willing to relocate and work from Padang Galak Sales & Marketing Office.

jobs.title: Finance Accounting Tax Superintendent - Tambang / Sawit/Konstruksi
jobs.description: URAIAN TUGAS DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB : 1. Perusahaan Pertambangan Tugas FAT Superintendent di sektor tambang sangat berfokus pada efisiensi biaya operasional alat berat, perizinan Royalti/PNBP, serta pengawasan biaya di area site/site office. Finance & Cost Control Pengendalian Cost per Ton : Mengendalikan biaya operasional penambangan (BBM, perawatan unit, suku cadang alat berat, dan subcontractor/hauling ). Kas Site & Head Office: Mengelola dana operasional lapangan ( petty cash site ) serta pengajuan pencairan dana berkala ke HO. Accounting Akuntansi Tambang & Aset: Mengelola pencatatan penyusutan alat berat, akuisisi lahan, biaya eksplorasi/eksploitasi, serta rekapitulasi persediaan ( stockpile inventory ). Rekonsiliasi Produksi: Mencocokkan data pencatatan transaksi akuntansi dengan laporan ritase/overburden (OB) dan penjualan kargo dari tim operasional/geologi. Taxation & Compliance Pajak & Retribusi Daerah: Mengelola kewajiban PPh Pasal 22 impor, PPh Pasal 23 jasa tambang/alat berat, PPN, Pajak Bahan Bakar (PBBKB), serta Pajak Air Tanah/Permukaan. Kepatuhan PNBP & Royalti: Memastikan perhitungan dan pembayaran Royalti (PNBP tambang) sesuai dengan harga patokan komoditas resmi pemerintah. 2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS) Fokus utama di industri sawit mencakup akuntansi biologis (kebun), pengeluaran Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), serta penanganan skema kemitraan plasma. Finance Arus Kas Musim Panen: Mengatur ketersediaan kas harian untuk pembelian Tandan Buah Segar (TBS) dari pihak ketiga/petani luar dan pengadaan pupuk skala besar. Manajemen Pembayaran Plasma: Memantau perhitungan dan pencairan dana bagi hasil untuk kebun kemitraan (Plasma/KUD). Accounting Akuntansi Aset Biologis (PSAK 69): Menghitung dan mencatat nilai wajar Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan (TBM) hingga menjadi Tanaman Menghasilkan (TM). HPP & Stok Minyak Sawit: Menghitung Biaya Pokok Produksi (HPP) Crude Palm Oil (CPO) dan Palm Kernel (PK) serta melakukan kontrol atas penyusutan stok di tangki timbun ( CPO storage tank ). Taxation Restitusi PPN: Mengelola pengajuan restitusi PPN secara rutin karena karakter usaha ekspor atau penyerahan CPO yang memicu lebih bayar. Pajak Khusus Perkebunan: Mengurus perhitungan Bea Keluar/Pungutan Ekspor CPO, PPh 22 Pembelian TBS dari Petani, serta PBB Sektor Perkebunan. 3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor FAT Superintendent di sektor konstruksi bertanggung jawab penuh terhadap akuntansi proyek, cash flow per proyek, serta penanganan potongan/retensi pembayaran. Finance Cash Flow Proyek: Memantau likuiditas untuk mendukung pembelian material, operasional subkontraktor, dan pembayaran upah tenaga kerja harian/borongan. Manajemen Penagihan (Termin): Menyusun dan memantau klaim penagihan ke pemilik proyek ( owner/client ) berdasarkan progres fisik. Accounting Akuntansi Kontrak Konstruksi (PSAK 72): Mengakui pendapatan dan beban berdasarkan persentase penyelesaian proyek ( percentage of completion method ). Pencatatan Retensi & WIP: Mengawasi pencatatan dana retensi proyek (yang ditahan client hingga masa pemeliharaan selesai) dan barang Work in Progress (WIP). Taxation PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi: Memastikan tarif PPh Final Pasal 4 ayat (2) diterapkan secara benar sesuai dengan Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU)/Kualifikasi Jasa Konstruksi yang dimiliki. PPN & Faktur Proyek: Memastikan e-Faktur diterbitkan sesuai saat terutang (saat pembayaran termin atau penyerahan progres) serta mencocokkan pajak masukan material bangunan. KUALFIKASI : Kualifikasi FAT Superintendent terbagi menjadi kualifikasi umum (keahlian mendasar) dan kualifikasi spesifik berdasarkan sektor industrinya. Kualifikasi Umum (General Requirements) Pendidikan: S1 Akuntansi / Keuangan / Manajemen Keuangan dari perguruan tinggi terkemuka. Pengalaman: Minimal 5–7 tahun di bidang FAT, dengan minimal 2–3 tahun pada posisi tingkat manajerial ( Supervisor , Assistant Manager , atau Superintendent ). Sertifikasi Profesional: Diutamakan memiliki sertifikasi Brevet A & B, CA ( Chartered Accountant ), atau CPA ( Certified Public Accountant ). Software Keuangan & ERP: Mahir menggunakan sistem ERP terintegrasi (seperti SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, atau Microsoft Dynamics 365) serta aplikasi perpajakan (e-Faktur, e-SPT, Coretax). Keahlian Manajerial: Memiliki kepemimpinan yang kuat, analisis keuangan ( financial modeling/analytical thinking ), pemecahan masalah, dan kemampuan komunikasi interpersonal. Kualifikasi Spesifik per Industri 1. Industri Pertambangan Pengalaman Sektor: Wajib berpengalaman di perusahaan tambang (batu bara, nikel, atau mineral lainnya) dan siap ditempatkan di site office (sistem kerja roster ). Regulasi & PNBP: Menguasai regulasi perpajakan sektor pertambangan, perhitungan PNBP (Royalti Tambang), PBBKB, dan Pajak Air Tanah. Manajemen Biaya Operasional: Memahami analisis Cost per Ton , manajemen persediaan stockpile , serta akuntansi aset berat dan akuisisi lahan. 2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS) Pengalaman Sektor: Memiliki rekam jejak di perusahaan kelapa sawit yang mencakup operasional kebun ( estate ) maupun Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS). Standar Akuntansi: Menguasai PSAK 69 (Aset Biologis/Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan & Tanaman Menghasilkan) dan perhitungan HPP CPO/Kernel. Kepatuhan Pajak Khusus: Terbiasa menangani pengajuan restitusi PPN (ekspor/lokal), Bea Keluar CPO, PBB Sektor Perkebunan, dan PPh 22 atas pembelian TBS dari mitra/plasma. 3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor Pengalaman Sektor: Berpengalaman di perusahaan kontraktor general, infrastruktur, atau EPC ( Engineering, Procurement, Construction ). Akuntansi Kontrak: Memahami pengakuan pendapatan berdasarkan metode Percentage of Completion (PSAK 72), penanganan Work in Progress (WIP), dan retensi proyek. Perpajakan Konstruksi: Menguasai ketentuan PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi (Pasal 4 ayat 2) berdasarkan Kualifikasi/SBU perusahaan dan regulasi perpajakan proyek multi-tahun ( multi-years contract ).

  • Cash Flow Proyek: Memantau likuiditas untuk mendukung pembelian material, operasional subkontraktor, dan pembayaran upah tenaga kerja harian/borongan.

  • Manajemen Penagihan (Termin): Menyusun dan memantau klaim penagihan ke pemilik proyek (owner/client) berdasarkan progres fisik.

Accounting

  • Akuntansi Kontrak Konstruksi (PSAK 72): Mengakui pendapatan dan beban berdasarkan persentase penyelesaian proyek (percentage of completion method).

  • Pencatatan Retensi & WIP: Mengawasi pencatatan dana retensi proyek (yang ditahan client hingga masa pemeliharaan selesai) dan barang Work in Progress (WIP).

Taxation

  • PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi: Memastikan tarif PPh Final Pasal 4 ayat (2) diterapkan secara benar sesuai dengan Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU)/Kualifikasi Jasa Konstruksi yang dimiliki.

  • PPN & Faktur Proyek: Memastikan e-Faktur diterbitkan sesuai saat terutang (saat pembayaran termin atau penyerahan progres) serta mencocokkan pajak masukan material bangunan.


KUALFIKASI :

Kualifikasi FAT Superintendent terbagi menjadi kualifikasi umum (keahlian mendasar) dan kualifikasi spesifik berdasarkan sektor industrinya.

Kualifikasi Umum (General Requirements)

  • Pendidikan: S1 Akuntansi / Keuangan / Manajemen Keuangan dari perguruan tinggi terkemuka.

  • Pengalaman: Minimal 5–7 tahun di bidang FAT, dengan minimal 2–3 tahun pada posisi tingkat manajerial (Supervisor, Assistant Manager, atau Superintendent).

  • Sertifikasi Profesional: Diutamakan memiliki sertifikasi Brevet A & B, CA (Chartered Accountant), atau CPA (Certified Public Accountant).

  • Software Keuangan & ERP: Mahir menggunakan sistem ERP terintegrasi (seperti SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, atau Microsoft Dynamics 365) serta aplikasi perpajakan (e-Faktur, e-SPT, Coretax).

  • Keahlian Manajerial: Memiliki kepemimpinan yang kuat, analisis keuangan (financial modeling/analytical thinking), pemecahan masalah, dan kemampuan komunikasi interpersonal.

Kualifikasi Spesifik per Industri

1. Industri Pertambangan

  • Pengalaman Sektor: Wajib berpengalaman di perusahaan tambang (batu bara, nikel, atau mineral lainnya) dan siap ditempatkan di site office (sistem kerja roster).

  • Regulasi & PNBP: Menguasai regulasi perpajakan sektor pertambangan, perhitungan PNBP (Royalti Tambang), PBBKB, dan Pajak Air Tanah.

  • Manajemen Biaya Operasional: Memahami analisis Cost per Ton, manajemen persediaan stockpile, serta akuntansi aset berat dan akuisisi lahan.

2. Perusahaan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (Agribisnis/PKS)

  • Pengalaman Sektor: Memiliki rekam jejak di perusahaan kelapa sawit yang mencakup operasional kebun (estate) maupun Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS).

  • Standar Akuntansi: Menguasai PSAK 69 (Aset Biologis/Tanaman Belum Menghasilkan & Tanaman Menghasilkan) dan perhitungan HPP CPO/Kernel.

  • Kepatuhan Pajak Khusus: Terbiasa menangani pengajuan restitusi PPN (ekspor/lokal), Bea Keluar CPO, PBB Sektor Perkebunan, dan PPh 22 atas pembelian TBS dari mitra/plasma.

3. Perusahaan Konstruksi & Kontraktor

  • Pengalaman Sektor: Berpengalaman di perusahaan kontraktor general, infrastruktur, atau EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction).

  • Akuntansi Kontrak: Memahami pengakuan pendapatan berdasarkan metode Percentage of Completion (PSAK 72), penanganan Work in Progress (WIP), dan retensi proyek.

  • Perpajakan Konstruksi: Menguasai ketentuan PPh Final Jasa Konstruksi (Pasal 4 ayat 2) berdasarkan Kualifikasi/SBU perusahaan dan regulasi perpajakan proyek multi-tahun (multi-years contract).

jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Sales Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan kami di BYD HAKA BALIKPAPAN (PT. BUMI HIJAU MOTOR) di Samarinda, Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Sales Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memimpin tim penjualan, mencapai target penjualan, dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. jobs.title: Front Office
jobs.description: Job Description Menyambut dan melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, serta memberikan pengalaman yang positif sesuai standar pelayanan SUNSRI Jewelry. Memberikan informasi mengenai produk, layanan, promo, dan kebijakan perusahaan kepada pelanggan. Melakukan follow-up kepada pelanggan terkait pesanan, pembayaran, pengambilan barang, maupun layanan purna jual (after-sales service). Menangani pertanyaan, permintaan, serta keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan memberikan solusi sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Gallery, Produksi, Inventory, dan divisi terkait untuk memastikan kebutuhan pelanggan terpenuhi dengan baik. Membantu proses administrasi operasional, termasuk pengarsipan dokumen dan penyusunan laporan harian. Memastikan area Front Office selalu bersih, rapi, nyaman, dan siap menyambut pelanggan. Menjaga kerahasiaan data pelanggan dan informasi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Front Office, Customer Service, Receptionist, atau posisi sejenis (fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar apabila memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, pelayanan pelanggan, dan interpersonal yang baik. Berpenampilan rapi, sopan, dan profesional. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, dan Outlook) serta komputer dengan baik. Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Indonesia dengan baik; kemampuan berbahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan, menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, disiplin, ramah, bertanggung jawab, serta mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, multitasking, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Diutamakan berdomisili di Gianyar, Denpasar dan sekitarnya Benefits Salary kompetitif. Meal & Transport Allowance. BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan. THR sesuai ketentuan perusahaan. Bonus/insentif berdasarkan kinerja. Kesempatan mengikuti pelatihan dan pengembangan diri. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, suportif, dan dinamis. Peluang pengembangan karier di SUNSRI Jewelry.

ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. We are on a journey to bring life-saving medicines to patients. Our role in contributing to decreasing mortality rates globally is clear – shaping the future by spotting a scientifically-led commercial opportunity and acting now to operationalise and scale it.

What you’ll do

Oncology Account Specialist would be responsible to develop territory and build strong customer relationships with the objective of maximizing sales volume and market share of oncology products on a given territory.

The job responsibilities includes:

  • Effectively implement sales strategy and tactics, plan of action (POA) in accordance with company policies

  • Regularly monitor territory’s sales performance to initiate appropriate actions to ensure performance is in line with objectives

  • Conduct analysis of market/competitors to identify territory business opportunities

  • Develop territory Business Plan based on POA and allocate resources (e.g. call activities, budget), for optimal sales impact

  • Monitor territory business plan to ensure resources are directed to customers of greatest potential

  • Participate in sales activities programs to increase product awareness in the market

  • Update territory customer segmentation classification, database and call records continuously

  • Explore and expand new customer base in line with SFE guidelines

  • Deliver key promotional messages within approved detail aids and in line with POA

  • Build trust and credibility with customers by demonstrating professionalism acting within the AZ Code of Conduct

  • Submit Monthly reports commenting on deviations from Business Plan and intended actions to align performance with objectives

  • Ensure punctual delivery of report

  • Develop behaviours leading to enhanced effectiveness as outlined in MR Competency definitions.

  • Identify areas for self-development and discuss developmental needs with FLSM

  • Attend & actively participate in sales meetings, product and sales training

  • Acts as a mentor/buddy/coach as project based (to support FLSMs) i.e :reps with lower performance, new reps in field introduction

Essential for the role

  • Bachelor Degree in any field, preferably science-related

  • Experience in Sales function, esp in Oncology Therapy Area.

  • High level of drive and determination

  • Good Interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills

Desirable for the role

  • Insightful Patient and Customer Journeys

  • Able to Thinks Strategically

  • Able to work in Agile Working environment

  • Has ability to Influence and inspire others

Why join AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.

  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

  • If you’re curious to know more then please reach out to Evita Rinaldy. We welcome your application.

jobs.title: General Manager Legal Corporate- Holding Company
jobs.description: Tugas Utama & Tanggung Jawab : Manajemen & Strategi Hukum: Merumuskan strategi hukum perusahaan, memberikan nasehat hukum ( legal advice ) kepada direksi/manajemen, serta memastikan seluruh operasional bisnis sejalan dengan regulasi pemerintah. Penyusunan & Peninjauan Kontrak ( Legal Drafting & Review ): Memimpin pembuatan, pemeriksaan, dan negosiasi semua perjanjian kerja sama, kontrak bisnis (lokal maupun internasional), serta dokumen legalitas lainnya. Kepatuhan Regulasi & Tata Kelola ( Corporate Governance ): Memastikan perusahaan mematuhi seluruh perundang-undangan ( compliance ), mengurus perizinan badan usaha, serta menerapkan prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG). Manajemen Sengketa & Litigasi ( Litigation & Dispute Resolution ): Menangani sengketa hukum, klaim, atau tuntutan terhadap perusahaan; serta berkoordinasi dengan pengacara/konsultan hukum eksternal jika kasus masuk ke ranah pengadilan. Corporate Action & Transaksi Strategis: Menangani aspek hukum terkait tindakan korporasi seperti akuisisi, merger, restrukturisasi perusahaan, penanaman modal, atau penerbitan saham/obligasi. Manajemen Tim & Aset Legal: Memimpin dan mengembangkan tim legal , serta mengelola dokumen dan lisensi legalitas perusahaan ( corporate secretary & legal documentation ). Kualifikasi : 1. Pendidikan & Sertifikasi Pendidikan Minimal: S1 Hukum (S.H.) dari universitas dengan reputasi baik. Gelar S2 (Magister Hukum/LL.M. atau MM/MBA) menjadi nilai tambah yang signifikan. Memiliki Lisensi / Sertifikasi Professional, menjadi nilai tambah : Lisensi Advokat aktif (PERADI atau organisasi advokat resmi lainnya) Sertifikasi Kepatuhan (Certified Legal Compliance Professional) atau Konsultan Hukum Pasar Modal, lebih disukai. 2. Pengalaman Kerja Pengalaman Minimum: Minimum 10–12 tahun pengalaman di bidang hukum bisnis (corporate legal). Pengalaman Manajerial: Minimum 3–5 tahun di posisi tingkat manajerial puncak (seperti Legal Manager, Head of Legal, atau Senior Legal Counsel). Pengalaman Kombinasi: Pengalaman bekerja di law firm terkemuka (sebagai Senior Associate atau Partner) dan/atau internal in-house counsel di perusahaan multinasional/korporasi besar sangat diutamakan. 3. Keahlian Teknis (Hard Skills) Keahlian Hukum Bisnis & Kontrak: Menguasai legal drafting, analisis kontrak komersial kompleks (lokal dan internasional), serta teknik negosiasi bisnis. Hukum Korporasi & Transaksi Strategis: Paham mendalam tentang Corporate Governance (GCG), UU PT, hukum perizinan, pertanahan/aset, serta proses Merger & Acquisition (M&A) atau corporate restructuring. Litigasi & Resolusi Sengketa: Memahami hukum acara dan strategi penanganan sengketa hukum (litigation dan arbitration). Kepatuhan Regulasi (Compliance): Menguasai regulasi spesifik industri tempat perusahaan bergerak (misalnya: perbankan/fintech, energi, manufaktur, atau ritel). Bahasa: Fasih berbahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris (lisan & tulisan) untuk kebutuhan negosiasi dan pembuatan dokumen hukum internasional. 4. Keterampilan Interpersonal & Kepemimpinan (Soft Skills) Strategic & Business Acumen: Mampu melihat masalah hukum dari sudut pandang bisnis dan memberikan solusi legal yang pragmatis tanpa menghambat pertumbuhan bisnis. Leadership & Team Management: Mampu memimpin, membimbing, dan mengembangkan tim hukum korporasi. Risk Management: Ketajaman dalam mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memitigasi risiko hukum sejak dini. Problem Solving & Communication: Keterampilan komunikasi yang persuasive serta kemampuan mengambil keputusan dalam situasi krisis atau sengketa.

  • Hukum Korporasi & Transaksi Strategis: Paham mendalam tentang Corporate Governance (GCG), UU PT, hukum perizinan, pertanahan/aset, serta proses Merger & Acquisition (M&A) atau corporate restructuring.

  • Litigasi & Resolusi Sengketa: Memahami hukum acara dan strategi penanganan sengketa hukum (litigation dan arbitration).

  • Kepatuhan Regulasi (Compliance): Menguasai regulasi spesifik industri tempat perusahaan bergerak (misalnya: perbankan/fintech, energi, manufaktur, atau ritel).

  • Bahasa: Fasih berbahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris (lisan & tulisan) untuk kebutuhan negosiasi dan pembuatan dokumen hukum internasional.

4. Keterampilan Interpersonal & Kepemimpinan (Soft Skills)

  • Strategic & Business Acumen: Mampu melihat masalah hukum dari sudut pandang bisnis dan memberikan solusi legal yang pragmatis tanpa menghambat pertumbuhan bisnis.

  • Leadership & Team Management: Mampu memimpin, membimbing, dan mengembangkan tim hukum korporasi.

  • Risk Management: Ketajaman dalam mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan memitigasi risiko hukum sejak dini.

  • Problem Solving & Communication: Keterampilan komunikasi yang persuasive serta kemampuan mengambil keputusan dalam situasi krisis atau sengketa.

jobs.title: Staff Quality Control
jobs.description: About the role Pisang Madu Pasti (PMP) is looking for a detail-oriented, disciplined, and quality-focused Staff Quality Control to ensure that product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and operational standards are consistently maintained across our outlets. You will conduct monitoring and inspection regularly to ensure all outlets implement SOP, product quality standards, cleanliness, and food safety according to PMP standards. Key responsibilities Conduct quality control and inspection routinely at outlets Ensure product quality meets established standards by checking taste, texture, appearance, size, and presentation Verify food safety, hygiene, and sanitation implementation at outlets Check cleanliness of production areas, equipment, storage, and service areas Ensure raw material storage complies with FIFO/FEFO standards and applicable regulations Check condition, quality, and expiration dates of raw materials Ensure employees follow production, handling, storage, and cleanliness SOPs Record inspection findings and prepare QC reports Provide corrective action recommendations for outlet findings and follow up until standards are met Coordinate with Operation, Production, and Outlet teams regarding quality improvements About you Minimum D3/S1 degree in Food Technology, Culinary Arts, Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, or related field Fresh graduates welcome; experience as QC in F&B is a plus Understanding of Quality Control basics, Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation Understanding of FIFO/FEFO principles, raw material storage, and food handling Detail-oriented, disciplined, assertive, with strong observation skills Able to identify problems and provide improvement recommendations Good communication and coordination abilities Able to prepare inspection reports neatly Able to work independently and in a team Willing to conduct visits/inspections to outlets as needed; personal vehicle and driving license are a plus Benefits Opportunity to grow with an expanding F&B brand Direct experience in managing quality control for F&B outlets Exposure to various aspects of food safety, product quality, and operational standards Opportunity to participate in quality improvement programs Learning & development with an experienced team Collaborative and dynamic work environment

About the role

Pisang Madu Pasti (PMP) is looking for a detail-oriented, disciplined, and quality-focused Staff Quality Control to ensure that product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and operational standards are consistently maintained across our outlets. You will conduct monitoring and inspection regularly to ensure all outlets implement SOP, product quality standards, cleanliness, and food safety according to PMP standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct quality control and inspection routinely at outlets

  • Ensure product quality meets established standards by checking taste, texture, appearance, size, and presentation

  • Verify food safety, hygiene, and sanitation implementation at outlets

  • Check cleanliness of production areas, equipment, storage, and service areas

  • Ensure raw material storage complies with FIFO/FEFO standards and applicable regulations

  • Check condition, quality, and expiration dates of raw materials

  • Ensure employees follow production, handling, storage, and cleanliness SOPs

  • Record inspection findings and prepare QC reports

  • Provide corrective action recommendations for outlet findings and follow up until standards are met

  • Coordinate with Operation, Production, and Outlet teams regarding quality improvements

About you

  • Minimum D3/S1 degree in Food Technology, Culinary Arts, Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, or related field

  • Fresh graduates welcome; experience as QC in F&B is a plus

  • Understanding of Quality Control basics, Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

  • Understanding of FIFO/FEFO principles, raw material storage, and food handling

  • Detail-oriented, disciplined, assertive, with strong observation skills

  • Able to identify problems and provide improvement recommendations

  • Good communication and coordination abilities

  • Able to prepare inspection reports neatly

  • Able to work independently and in a team

  • Willing to conduct visits/inspections to outlets as needed; personal vehicle and driving license are a plus

Benefits

  • Opportunity to grow with an expanding F&B brand

  • Direct experience in managing quality control for F&B outlets

  • Exposure to various aspects of food safety, product quality, and operational standards

  • Opportunity to participate in quality improvement programs

  • Learning & development with an experienced team

  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia. Get to Know the Role In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, system design thinking, and a commitment to building platforms that simplify complexity rather than spread it around. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead the architectural design of microservices, high-throughput APIs, and data storage solutions built to handle scale and high availability. Diagnose high-stakes performance bottlenecks, refactor core infrastructure, and ensure low latency across distributed systems. Own end-to-end delivery of mission-critical systems—from writing technical design documents (TDDs) and scoping projects to deploying and maintaining production features. Drive code quality across the team through high-bar code reviews, system reliability standards, and technical mentorship of mid/junior engineers. Oversee cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), automated CI/CD pipelines, security protocols, and robust incident management/observability to guarantee strict SLAs.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Get to Know the Team At Financial Services, the Payment team builds end-to-end payment experiences and platforms that help merchants accept payments and grow across Southeast Asia. We empower frictionless checkouts with configurable, developer-friendly capabilities—so partners can embed payments and iterate quickly. From QR payments to lending repayments and in-person acceptance flows, we work across multiple payment journeys to deliver reliable user and merchant outcomes. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a experienced and passionate backend engineer to join our Tech Family. You will develop scalable backend systems that power products used by millions of people across Southeast Asia. You will be expected to take ownership of complex technical problems end to end, drive high-quality execution, and raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, collaboration, and mentorship. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be based in our Jakarta Office The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Lead the design, and operation of scalable, maintainable, and reliable backend services and platform components. Convert product and requirements into technical solutions while driving design discussions and architectural trade-offs. Oversee the delivery of high-quality code by maintaining standards in testing, performance, observability, and rigorous code reviews. Partner with product, business, mobile, web, data, and infrastructure teams to solve end-to-end-user and system challenges. Improve service reliability through monitoring, proactive system health fixes, incident response, and root cause analysis. Participate in the team's on-call rotation and take active ownership during production incidents. Guide engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. Identify and guide ongoing improvements in engineering processes, developer productivity, and overall system health.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing - Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description: Ringkasan Deskripsi Pekerjaan Digital Marketing Merencanakan dan menjalankan strategi Digital & Social Media Marketing. Membuat ide dan konsep konten untuk Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan platform digital lainnya. Mengelola media sosial dan membuat copywriting/caption yang menarik. Melakukan riset tren, kompetitor, dan target audience. Menjalankan dan mengoptimalkan campaign/Meta Ads. Menganalisis performa konten dan campaign serta membuat report & insight. Membantu meningkatkan awareness, engagement, leads, dan conversion. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Designer, Video Editor, dan Content Creator. Graphic Designer & Video Editor Membuat desain grafis untuk kebutuhan Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, website, dan media digital lainnya. Membuat desain konten promosi, branding, iklan, dan kebutuhan visual perusahaan. Melakukan editing video untuk Reels, TikTok, Shorts, dan konten promosi. Mengembangkan konsep visual yang kreatif dan sesuai dengan identitas brand. Membuat desain berdasarkan brief dan kebutuhan campaign. Melakukan revisi desain/video sesuai feedback. Mengikuti tren desain, video editing, dan konten media sosial. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Digital Marketing dan Content Creator. Memastikan hasil desain dan video memiliki kualitas visual yang baik dan konsisten. Syarat Pekerjaan Digital Marketing Maksimal usia 30 tahun. Minimal S1, semua jurusan. Pengalaman Digital Marketing, Ads, SEO, atau Social Media Management. Memahami dasar Digital & Social Media Marketing. Familiar dengan Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, dan Meta Business Suite. Memiliki kemampuan copywriting dan komunikasi yang baik. Kreatif, mengikuti tren, dan mampu menghasilkan ide konten. Memahami dasar Meta Ads dan analisis performa. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Disiplin, komunikatif, bertanggung jawab, dan mau belajar. Subjek Email: DMADS Nama Graphic Designer & Video Editor Maksimal usia 30 tahun. S-1 (Semua Jurusan) Memahami dasar-dasar desain grafis dan editing video. Menguasai software seperti Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, atau software sejenis. Memiliki kemampuan membuat desain yang menarik dan komunikatif. Memahami dasar layout, typography, warna, dan visual branding. Kreatif, memiliki sense of design yang baik, dan mengikuti tren visual. Mampu melakukan editing video untuk konten media sosial. Memiliki portfolio desain/video menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun bersama tim. Bertanggung jawab, disiplin, komunikatif, dan mau belajar. Subjek Email: GDVE_Nama Anda Lampirkan: CV Surat lamaran Portofolio Scan ijazah Transkrip nilai Kirim Lamaran Lowongan Terkait

jobs.description: About the job Our data centers support the digital services, businesses and ideas driving communities forward. As TERA grows in Indonesia, timely and disciplined regulatory execution is essential to keeping our projects on schedule, maintaining operational readiness and supporting responsible growth. Reporting to the Head of Public Policy and Government Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager will own the end to end execution of licenses, permits, registrations, regulatory approvals, amendments and renewals across development, construction, commissioning and operations. This is an operational delivery role. Broader stakeholder engagement and strategic resources policy are led by separate members of the team. Responsibilities Lead Regulatory Affairs and Permitting • Develop and maintain a complete regulatory and permitting roadmap for each data center campus, covering development, construction, commissioning, operations and renewal requirements. • Manage applications, amendments, renewals and maintenance of all required licenses, permits, registrations and regulatory approvals. • Identify applicable requirements under Indonesian business licensing and sector regulations, including requirements administered through OSS and relevant national and regional authorities. • Communicate directly with regulatory and licensing offices to clarify requirements, submit applications, respond to questions, follow up on processing and resolve application specific issues. Protect Project Delivery • Translate regulatory requirements into clear actions, document lists, accountable owners, dependencies and target completion dates for internal project teams. • Integrate permit and approval milestones into project schedules and identify regulatory risks that could affect construction, energization, commissioning or operations. • Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval. • Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support. Coordinate Regulatory Execution • Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely. • Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams. • Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution. • Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements. Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field. • At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia. • Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices. • Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions. • Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills. • Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions. • Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders. • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector. • Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies. • The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments. • Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.

About the job

Our data centers support the digital services, businesses and ideas driving communities forward. As TERA grows in Indonesia, timely and disciplined regulatory execution is essential to keeping our projects on schedule, maintaining operational readiness and supporting responsible growth.

Reporting to the Head of Public Policy and Government Affairs, the Regulatory Affairs and Permitting Manager will own the end to end execution of licenses, permits, registrations, regulatory approvals, amendments and renewals across development, construction, commissioning and operations. This is an operational delivery role. Broader stakeholder engagement and strategic resources policy are led by separate members of the team.

Responsibilities

Lead Regulatory Affairs and Permitting

• Develop and maintain a complete regulatory and permitting roadmap for each data center campus, covering development, construction, commissioning, operations and renewal requirements.

• Manage applications, amendments, renewals and maintenance of all required licenses, permits, registrations and regulatory approvals.

• Identify applicable requirements under Indonesian business licensing and sector regulations, including requirements administered through OSS and relevant national and regional authorities.

• Communicate directly with regulatory and licensing offices to clarify requirements, submit applications, respond to questions, follow up on processing and resolve application specific issues.


Protect Project Delivery

• Translate regulatory requirements into clear actions, document lists, accountable owners, dependencies and target completion dates for internal project teams.

• Integrate permit and approval milestones into project schedules and identify regulatory risks that could affect construction, energization, commissioning or operations.

• Maintain an accurate permit tracker and document repository, including application status, validity periods, renewal deadlines, dependencies, responsible owners and evidence of approval.

• Escalate stalled, high risk or schedule critical approvals with a clear assessment of the issue, project impact, recommended action and required support.


Coordinate Regulatory Execution

• Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Environment Health and Safety, Finance and external consultants to ensure submissions are complete, accurate and timely.

• Monitor regulatory changes that directly affect licensing, permitting and data center operations, and communicate practical implications to relevant internal teams.

• Coordinate with Stakeholder Relations when senior government engagement or institutional escalation is required, and with Strategic Resources Policy on matters involving electricity, water, telecommunications, land and other critical resources, while retaining ownership of permit execution.

• Conduct all regulatory interactions and submissions in accordance with company ethics, anti bribery, record keeping and approval requirements.


Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Public Policy, Engineering or another relevant field.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in regulatory affairs, licensing, permitting, project approvals or operational compliance in Indonesia.

• Hands on experience independently managing license or permit applications with government authorities and licensing offices.

• Good working knowledge of Indonesian business licensing processes, including OSS, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical project actions.

• Strong project management, documentation, coordination, follow up and problem solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively with technical teams and understand engineering or construction documents sufficiently to manage regulatory submissions.

• Professional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regulatory authorities, consultants and internal stakeholders.

• Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with willingness to travel regularly to government offices, project sites and data center campuses.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data centers, telecommunications, power, infrastructure, construction, industrial estates, manufacturing, energy or another regulated sector.

• Experience managing regulatory requirements across multiple projects or campuses with competing deadlines and approval dependencies.

• The ability to operate effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and resource constrained environments.

• Mandarin proficiency is helpful but not required.
