jobs.title: Data Center Facility Engineer – Colocation / Commercial DC
jobs.description: Duties and Responsibilities: • Lead and manage facilities technicians to operate and maintain mission critical facilities of data centres on 24x7 basis to achieve service level requirements and specifications. • Project engineer of addition & alternation works of new and existing customers. • Manage contractors and vendors in operation, maintenance and repair of mission critical facilities. • Respond to emergencies and lead the facilities technicians and service vendors to resume availability and service levels of the data centres. • Develop, review and revise operation & maintenance requirements, procedures and programmes with internal parties and service vendors. Evaluate vendor performance and report to manager. • Participate in ISO certifications and audits. • Maintain and update accurate inventories of facilities, apparatus and tools. • Lead and train technicians to follow and comply with standard operating procedures, escalation procedures, incident & change procedures. • Assist reporting manager in administration of the facilities team. • Work in Shifting model (6 days duty – 2 days off) disregarding public holiday, 8 hours per Day. Qualification and Experience: • Degree / Higher Diploma graduates in Building Services/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent • 3 years or above experience in operation and maintenance of 24x7 mission critical facilities • Good team player, strong project management, communication, presentation and problem-solving skills.

Mampu menghasilkan output desain sesuai kuota harian yang ditetapkan (misal: feed/story harian, materi promosi harian). jobs.title: Fashion Designer – DAYS (Penempatan : Jakarta)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan : Mengembangkan konsep dan desain koleksi menswear & womenswear sesuai dengan DNA dan target market DAYS. Menerjemahkan batik dan elemen tradisional Indonesia menjadi desain yang modern, contemporary, dan wearable untuk kebutuhan sehari-hari. Melakukan fashion & market trend research serta menerjemahkannya menjadi moodboard, color direction, silhouette, dan collection concept. Mengembangkan desain mulai dari sketch, technical drawing, fabric & color selection, hingga sample development. Memiliki kemampuan untuk melakukan mix & match motif, placement motif, serta eksplorasi motif batik sesuai kebutuhan desain. Berkoordinasi dengan pattern maker, sample team, merchandising, dan production team selama proses pengembangan produk. Melakukan fitting dan memberikan adjustment/revisi hingga produk mencapai standar desain dan fit yang diinginkan. Memahami kebutuhan komersial dan mampu menyeimbangkan antara creativity, wearability, dan marketability. Aktif mengikuti perkembangan fashion, lifestyle, youth culture, dan contemporary Indonesian brands sebagai referensi pengembangan produk. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Fashion Design, Tata Busana, Textile Design, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman 2–5 tahun sebagai Fashion Designer, preferably di fashion retail atau ready-to-wear brand. Memiliki strong fashion sense dan good aesthetic judgment, khususnya untuk contemporary & casual fashion. Memahami dasar pattern, garment construction, fabric, fitting, dan production process. Memiliki pemahaman mengenai batik, textile, motif, color composition, dan print development menjadi nilai tambah. Menguasai Adobe Illustrator & Photoshop; kemampuan menggunakan software fashion design lainnya menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu membuat technical drawing / fashion flat yang jelas untuk kebutuhan development dan produksi. Up-to-date terhadap perkembangan fashion trends, styling, colors, silhouettes, dan consumer preferences. Kreatif, detail-oriented, terbuka terhadap feedback, dan nyaman bekerja secara kolaboratif. Memiliki kemampuan time management yang baik dan terbiasa bekerja dengan beberapa collection/development timeline sekaligus. Wajib menyertakan portfolio yang menunjukkan proses desain dari concept/moodboard hingga final product.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Requirements: Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Information Technology is preferred. 1–2 years of experience in account management, software sales, IT solutions sales, or a client-facing consulting role. Neat, presentable, and professional appearance. Strong and convincing presentation skills. Ability to manage the end-to-end sales process, from lead generation, negotiation, to deal closure. Target-oriented with strong work resilience. Communicative and proficient in English, both spoken and written. Skilled in using Microsoft Office. Have a basic technical understanding of IT solutions (applications, software, IT services). Experience selling to or interacting with clients in the banking/financial services sector is an advantage. Willing to work overtime and attend meetings outside regular working hours. Job description: Conduct prospecting and lead validation within the banking and financial institution sectors. Conduct outreach, product presentations, and demos to potential clients. Develop weekly and monthly sales action plans. Achieve established sales targets, including client retention and contract renewal targets. Prepare Minutes of Meeting (MoM) and periodically report on sales activities and account health. Manage sales documents and administration in a neat and systematic manner. Manage the end-to-end account lifecycle: onboarding, presentations, proposal preparation, negotiations, contracting, implementation, and post-implementation follow-up to ensure client satisfaction. Monitor account performance, identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and support the client contract renewal process.

jobs.description: 2–5 years of experience in Beauty, Cosmetics, FMCG, Retail or Optical. Experience in retail operations, channel operations, trade marketing or key account management. Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong Plus Experience with Beauty Stores or Optical Stores. Experience managing multi-store retail operations. Experience with merchandising and store activation. Existing relationships with Beauty / Optical retailers. Experience working with an emerging or fast-growing brand. Experience connecting offline retail with Instagram and Tiktok 1.Retail Channel Operations Manage day-to-day operations of offline retail accounts. Coordinate product onboarding, replenishment, inventory and store execution. Monitor store-level sales and sell-through performance. Identify underperforming stores and implement improvement plans. Manage communication with retail partners and store teams. 2. Merchandising & Store Execution Develop and maintain product displays, POSM and in-store visibility. Develop mechanisms to connect offline customers with TikTok, Instagram and e-commerce channels. 5. Data & Performance Management

jobs.title: Sales
jobs.description: Tugas & Tanggung Jawab: Menyusun dan menjalankan strategi penjualan untuk mencapai target perusahaan. Melakukan riset pasar untuk memahami kebutuhan, tren, dan peluang penjualan. Mencari dan mengembangkan prospek atau calon customer baru. Melakukan pendekatan, presentasi, dan negosiasi dengan calon customer. Menindaklanjuti prospek hingga proses penjualan selesai. Menjaga hubungan baik dengan customer dan membangun jaringan bisnis. Bertanggung jawab mencapai target penjualan mingguan, bulanan, dan tahunan. Membuat laporan aktivitas dan pencapaian penjualan secara berkala. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, D3/S1 lebih diutamakan. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Sales/Marketing, diutamakan di industri properti. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan persuasi yang baik. Berorientasi pada target dan memiliki motivasi tinggi dalam mencapai hasil. Proaktif, percaya diri, disiplin, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan customer. Memiliki networking yang luas menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia melakukan aktivitas sales di lapangan.

jobs.title: Warehouse Helper
jobs.description: Job Description Inbound : Membongkar muatan dari truk pengirim, memeriksa kondisi fisik barang dari kerusakan/kekurangan, serta mencatat data barang yang masuk. Pengambilan & Pengemasan (Pick & Pack): Membaca daftar pesanan (pick sheet) atau menggunakan barcode scanner untuk mengambil barang, mengemasnya dengan aman, dan menempelkan label pengiriman yang sesuai. Pengelolaan Stok & Inventaris: Menata barang di rak atau area penyimpanan yang ditentukan, menjaga keteraturan lokasi stok, serta membantu proses perhitungan stok berkala (stock opname). Outbond: Memuat barang yang siap dikirim ke atas truk pengangkut atau armada kurir sesuai dengan jadwal yang ditetapkan. Pemeliharaan Alat & Area Kerja: Mengoperasikan alat pemindah barang manual (seperti hand truck atau pallet jack), menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area kerja, serta mematuhi seluruh standar keselamatan kerja (K3). Job Requirements Laki - Laki Memahami dasar operasional pergudangan Mampu melakukan penerimaan, penyimpanan, penyiapan dan pemindahan material sesuai SOP Teliti dalam handling material Mampu bekerja dalam team Berpengalaman sebagai warehouse helper Maksimal Usia 40 tahun

jobs.title: Customer Service Laundry
jobs.description: About the role EASY DAY LAUNDRY membuka kesempatan bergabung sebagai Customer Service untuk melayani pelanggan dengan ramah, profesional, dan penuh tanggung jawab. Kualifikasi: · Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara. · Ramah, memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, dan berpenampilan rapi serta profesional. · Mampu menggunakan komputer/smartphone untuk input data (WhatsApp, aplikasi kasir, Excel dasar). · Teliti, jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. · Pengalaman di bidang customer service, retail, atau hospitality menjadi nilai tambah. · Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift dan di akhir pekan. · Bersedia mengantarkan pakaian pelanggan bila diperlukan. · Mampu melakukan percakapan dasar dalam Bahasa Inggris. Keahlian yang Diutamakan: · Service oriented – berfokus pada kepuasan pelanggan. · Memiliki kemampuan problem solving. · Mampu bekerja dengan baik dalam tim maupun mandiri. jobs.title: Data Center - Structure/Civil Engineer (Design & Construction)
jobs.description: Duties and Responsibilities: • Assist in the planning, design, and delivery of civil and structural engineering works for greenfield and brownfield data center projects. • Perform structural analysis and design calculations for reinforced concrete, structural steel, masonry, and other structural systems in accordance with applicable codes and project requirements. • Prepare and review engineering calculations, design reports, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. • Coordinate with internal engineering teams, external consultants, contractors, and vendors to ensure timely and accurate delivery of structural design packages. • Review structural designs and engineering deliverables to ensure compliance with company standards, client requirements, and applicable local regulations. • Support the resolution of technical design issues and provide engineering solutions throughout the design and construction phases. • Provide technical support during construction, including responding to Requests for Information (RFIs), reviewing shop drawings, material submittals, and resolving site- related engineering issues. • Attend design coordination meetings, site inspections, construction progress meetings, testing, and commissioning activities as required. • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering interfaces, including architectural, electrical, mechanical, geotechnical, and utilities disciplines. • Support budget estimation, value engineering, and constructability reviews to optimize project cost without compromising quality, safety, or reliability. • Monitor assigned engineering activities to ensure deliverables are completed within agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. • Maintain accurate engineering documentation, design records, and project files in accordance with company procedures. • Assist in mentoring junior engineers and providing technical guidance to support team development. • Support liaison activities with clients, consultants, contractors, and relevant government authorities to facilitate design reviews, approvals, and project execution. • Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, building codes, statutory regulations, health, safety, and environmental requirements. Qualifications and Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline AND/OR Evidence of Exceptional ability for the role. • At least 5 years of specialization structural design experience in data center design and/or construction. • Familiar with data center design requirements, including equipment loading, raised floor systems, equipment foundations, cable trenches, utility structures, and building resilience. • Experience supporting construction activities, reviewing shop drawings, responding to RFIs, and resolving site engineering issues.

jobs.description: Waruna Shipping Group is a leading shipowner and shipyard company specializing in providing innovative and efficient shipping solutions. We are committed to operational excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance across our fleet. We are looking for an experienced Engine Trainer – Tanker to support the continuous development and competency of our ship crews. This role will be responsible for planning, delivering, monitoring, and evaluating training programs to strengthen crew capabilities and ensure safe, efficient, and compliant vessel operations. Responsibilities Conduct Crew Training Needs Analysis (TNA) based on operational requirements and crew competency Develop and maintain training plans, schedules, and training matrices for shipboard personnel Plan and implement crew familiarization programs for newly joined and existing crew Develop relevant training concepts, modules, and materials for engine department personnel Deliver technical and competency-based training onboard vessels Evaluate training effectiveness and crew performance, and recommend improvement actions. Prepare and manage training budgets Maintain accurate training records, documentation, and administration Monitor and follow up on crew development and competency improvement Conduct onboard visits and training assignments as required Qualifications ATT I (Class I Marine Engineer Certificate) Minimum 3 years of sailing experience as Chief Engineer on tanker vessels with minimum 10,000 DWT Strong practical experience in tanker engine room operations Preferably have 2 years of shore-based experience in the shipping industry, particularly in a training or crew development function Previous experience as a Trainer is highly preferred TOT IMO Model Course 6.09 certification is preferred Strong knowledge and practical experience in: Boiler operation, Fuel Oil & Lube Oil Purifier operation and setup, Engine room equipment and machinery, Engine room safety and operational procedures, Crew competency and familiarization Strong skills in Training Delivery, Training Management, Performance Management, and Organizational Development Excellent communication, presentation, coaching, and interpersonal skills Willing and able to travel and be assigned onboard vessels to conduct training At Waruna Shipping Group , we are committed to developing capable maritime professionals and maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence, reliability, and regulatory compliance across our fleet. As an Engine Trainer - Tanker, you will play an important role in strengthening crew competency, improving onboard performance, and supporting the continuous development of our tanker fleet. Ready to bring your seagoing expertise ashore and make an impact through training? Apply now and grow your maritime career with Waruna Shipping Group.

jobs.title: Sales B2B
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Mengidentifikasi, prospek, dan mengembangkan peluang bisnis baru dengan klien B2B potensial melalui riset pasar dan jaringan profesional. Melakukan presentasi dan demonstrasi produk atau layanan kepada prospek dan klien untuk mengkomunikasikan nilai proposisi perusahaan. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan jangka panjang dengan klien korporat untuk memastikan kepuasan dan peluang penjualan tambahan. Mengelola pipeline penjualan, mencatat semua interaksi klien, dan memperbarui sistem CRM secara konsisten. Melakukan negosiasi dengan klien untuk mencapai kesepakatan yang menguntungkan dan memaksimalkan nilai transaksi. Memenuhi dan melampaui target penjualan bulanan dan kuartalan yang telah ditetapkan. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal termasuk tim produk, layanan pelanggan, dan operasional untuk memastikan kesuksesan klien. Mengumpulkan umpan balik pasar dan memberikan insights kepada manajemen untuk meningkatkan strategi penjualan dan positioning produk. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Sarjana dalam Bisnis, Manajemen, Penjualan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman di bidang penjualan B2B atau pengembangan bisnis baru. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang siklus penjualan B2B dan proses pengambilan keputusan klien korporat. Kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang sangat baik dengan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat. Keahlian dalam negosiasi dan closing penjualan dengan track record pemenuhi target yang konsisten. Kemampuan analitis yang baik dan keterampilan problem-solving untuk mengidentifikasi kebutuhan klien. Penguasaan perangkat CRM dan alat sales enablement lainnya. Kemampuan untuk bekerja secara independen dan dalam tim dengan motivasi diri yang tinggi. Memiliki network atau koneksi di industri target adalah nilai tambah. Kesediaan untuk melakukan perjalanan bisnis jika diperlukan.

jobs.title: Junior HRGA Manager
jobs.description: About the role We are a growing Advertising Agency, seeking an experienced Junior HRGA Manager to join our team. You are the only contributor in HRGA, direct report to Director and HRGA Manager. Available to join ASAP. What you'll be doing Assist with the full cycle of the human resources process, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, and performance management Provide and execute general administrative support, such as managing leave forms, office supplies, travel arrangements, and other daily operations. Contribute to the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address HR-related matters and provide solutions Collaborate with school and universities to find best candidates Update and process BPJS, payroll, pph 21 and other allowances As a point of contact for labour matters to BPJS and Disnaker Update the contracts or agreements with vendors and employees Process monthly HRGA payment (tools subscriptions, daily/freelance worker, office rent, etc.) Maintain accurate employee records and databases Support the HR team in organising employee annual events Assist with other HR-related tasks as required What we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field Min. 2 years of experience in a similar HR Generalist (Supervisor or Assistant Manager role) Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail. Will be working in fast and dynamic environment Excellent communication, diplomatic yet empathic Proficiency in Google Workspace, Ms. Office and HR information systems (tech savvy) Ability to work independently and as part of a team Deep understanding of Indonesian labour laws and HR best practices Willing to commute to our office in Ciputat (Tangerang Selatan) What we offer We are committed to providing a supportive and collaborative work environment that fosters personal and professional growth. As a member of our team, you can expect: Competitive benefits package (Medical, Insurance) Hybrid working (3-4 days WFO per week)

About the role
We are a growing Advertising Agency, seeking an experienced Junior HRGA Manager to join our team. You are the only contributor in HRGA, direct report to Director and HRGA Manager. Available to join ASAP.


What you'll be doing

  • Assist with the full cycle of the human resources process, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, and performance management

  • Provide and execute general administrative support, such as managing leave forms, office supplies, travel arrangements, and other daily operations.

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address HR-related matters and provide solutions

  • Collaborate with school and universities to find best candidates

  • Update and process BPJS, payroll, pph 21 and other allowances

  • As a point of contact for labour matters to BPJS and Disnaker

  • Update the contracts or agreements with vendors and employees

  • Process monthly HRGA payment (tools subscriptions, daily/freelance worker, office rent, etc.)

  • Maintain accurate employee records and databases

  • Support the HR team in organising employee annual events

  • Assist with other HR-related tasks as required

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Min. 2 years of experience in a similar HR Generalist (Supervisor or Assistant Manager role)

  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail. Will be working in fast and dynamic environment

  • Excellent communication, diplomatic yet empathic

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Ms. Office and HR information systems (tech savvy)

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Deep understanding of Indonesian labour laws and HR best practices

  • Willing to commute to our office in Ciputat (Tangerang Selatan)

What we offer

We are committed to providing a supportive and collaborative work environment that fosters personal and professional growth. As a member of our team, you can expect:

  • Competitive benefits package (Medical, Insurance)

  • Hybrid working (3-4 days WFO per week)

jobs.title: Staff (Group Leader) - Production Garment
jobs.description: REQUIREMENTS: Candidate must possess at least bachelor's degree in Chemical, Industrial Engineering, Phycology, Human Resources Development or equivalent Required language(s): English Speaking Active Experience 1 year or more of working experience in the related field is advantage. Preferably Staff (non-management & non-supervisor) specialized in Manufacturing/Production Operations or equivalent. Advance in Microsoft office (Excel, Word, etc). Strong knowledge of garment production processes, quality standards, and lean manufacturing. High leadership, negotiation & communication skills. Must have safe and healthy - minded JOB DESCRIPTION: Responsible to lead team consists of 60 more employees (4 lines) Supervise daily production activities to ensure target output, quality, and efficiency are met. Communicate daily targets/goals to Team Leaders (TL’s) and monitor performance/address any deviations in areas such as material consumption and performance to plan in order to achieve daily/ weekly/monthly targets. Support the Team Leader in handling abnormalities by doing data-based problem solving using 5-why and 8-step thinking and seek assistance from support teams as and when required. Work with other processes in the value stream such as - (New product integration & QCO, Cutting & Raw Material, Technical & Quality, engineering etc.) in order to anticipate and address issues that can impact the smooth flow of the value stream/ production process. Be a representative as the first level of HR support by assisting in new Team Member selection and orientation and by attending to the following duties (Leave approval, Absenteeism management, conducting performance evaluations of both TL & TM, Planning/managing TL/TM skill development. Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures (SOP) and workplace safety standards. Provide coaching, motivation, and discipline to production operators to achieve performance goals.

jobs.title: Maintenance Manager
jobs.description: Job Description: Memimpin, mengarahkan, dan mengelola tim Maintenance Coordinator, Admin, dan Teknisi. Mengatur pembagian tugas, prioritas pekerjaan, serta melakukan monitoring dan evaluasi kinerja tim. Memastikan kebutuhan maintenance seluruh store berjalan efektif dan tepat waktu. Mengontrol pelaksanaan preventive & corrective maintenance serta mengevaluasi hasil pekerjaan tim dan vendor. Mengelola dan melakukan negosiasi dengan vendor/supplier. Mengontrol pengadaan, budget, cost, dan efisiensi maintenance. Melakukan cost-benefit analysis sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan maintenance. Menangani eskalasi permasalahan maintenance dan memberikan solusi kepada manajemen. Membuat laporan kinerja dan improvement maintenance secara berkala. Qualifications: Pendidikan minimal S1 Manajemen, Teknik Sipil atau Teknik Mesin. Lebih diutamakan lulusan Manajemen dengan pengalaman relevan di bidang maintenance/facility serta kemampuan analisis, cost-benefit, dan cost control. Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang maintenance/facility/operasional sebagai Supervisor, Coordinator, atau Manager. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, people management, dan team coordination yang kuat. Mampu mengelola dan mengembangkan kinerja tim. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, analisis, dan cost efficiency yang baik. Mampu mengelola dan bernegosiasi dengan vendor/supplier. Memahami preventive & corrective maintenance serta pengelolaan anggaran. Menguasai Microsoft Office, terutama Excel. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke luar kota.

jobs.title: Internal Control Officer
jobs.description: Are you interested in Internal Control and looking to grow your career in this field? Join us! What You Will Do: Review and evaluate company policies and procedures to ensure they remain relevant and effective. Support and maintain the implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) across the organization. Maintain and monitor the Whistleblowing System to ensure it is properly implemented. Review the effectiveness of internal controls across Kapal Api Global (KAG) and its Strategic Business Units (SBU). Provide recommendations to strengthen internal controls and improve business processes. We Are Looking For You Who: Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Accounting, Finance, or a related field with GPA 3.00. Have 1–3 years of experience in Internal Audit and/or Internal Control. Have a good understanding of SOP & Policy development, process mapping, and business processes. Proficient in Microsoft Office. Willing to travel for business trips. What You Will Get: Accelerated career growth and plenty of learning opportunities. A challenging yet supportive working environment.

jobs.title: Data Center Facility Engineer – Colocation / Commercial DC
jobs.description: Duties and Responsibilities: • Lead and manage facilities technicians to operate and maintain mission critical facilities of data centres on 24x7 basis to achieve service level requirements and specifications. • Project engineer of addition & alternation works of new and existing customers. • Manage contractors and vendors in operation, maintenance and repair of mission critical facilities. • Respond to emergencies and lead the facilities technicians and service vendors to resume availability and service levels of the data centres. • Develop, review and revise operation & maintenance requirements, procedures and programmes with internal parties and service vendors. Evaluate vendor performance and report to manager. • Participate in ISO certifications and audits. • Maintain and update accurate inventories of facilities, apparatus and tools. • Lead and train technicians to follow and comply with standard operating procedures, escalation procedures, incident & change procedures. • Assist reporting manager in administration of the facilities team. • Work in Shifting model (6 days duty – 2 days off) disregarding public holiday, 8 hours per Day. Qualification and Experience: • Degree / Higher Diploma graduates in Building Services/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent • 3 years or above experience in operation and maintenance of 24x7 mission critical facilities • Good team player, strong project management, communication, presentation and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Data Center Project Engineer  (Design & Construction)
jobs.description: Duties and Responsibilities ● To support Project Manager to establish project objectives, policies, procedures and performance standards within boundaries of corporate policies. Put these in clear concise work statement for the field. ● To work with the guidance of the Project Manager to negotiate and supervise the preparation of all change orders on the project. ● Maintain all logs required to track the progress of the project. ● Work closely with a Project Assistant or external Project Manager in the maintenance of project required tracking devices. ● Maintain liaison with prime client and A/E to facilitate construction activities. ● Monitor construction activities in conjunction with the onsite Foreman and Area Superintendent to ensure project is being built on schedule, quality and within budgets ● Investigate any potentially serious situations and implement corrective measures within company guidelines, and under supervision ● Represent company/project in meetings with subcontractors, suppliers & consultant. ● Monitor and control Project schedule (Primavera/Microsoft Projects), as per project manager schedule plan ● Assist Project Manager to monitor financial aspects of contracts (progress billing, rental equipment, income/expenses) to protect the company's interest and simultaneously maintain good relationship with the client ● The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the position’s role within the business unit. ● Supporting Project Manager to develop project proposal and plan based on the business requirements and available project resources together with the guidance of Project Manager ● Direct and coordinate activities of project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within the prescribes budget of resources. ● Track ETA delivery of equipment and services from Telco/Data Centres, Public Cloud Providers and ICT Principles/Distributors. ● Provide regular reports on project progress for stakeholders and management and update schedules on plans when required. ● Serve as an onsite escalation point for any service impacted incidents and help with ad-hoc requests to provide optimal user experience to BU. Communicate with stakeholder for vendor management, maintenance of documents and to report on project progress. Qualification and Experience: ● Bachelor's Degree or Diploma of Electrical/ Civil / Mechanical Engineering discipline with a minimum 3 years of relevant Data Center project management or operations experience. ● Possesses experience in Data Center Design is mandatory. ● Experience in Greenfield and Brownfield would be a plus point. ● Possesses some Operation experience would be a plus point. ● Able to deliver projects within cost and time parameters. ● Strong stakeholder management capabilities, and strategic mindset to advise and manage both internal and external partners. ● Good project management skills and high-quality successful project delivery experiences. ● Good reporting/documentation skills to ensure, timely, clear and concise information flow among all stakeholders. ● Result oriented, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to drill down to details to ensure the progression of the respective projects. ● Possess a strong network relationship in the vendor and regulatory ecosystem.

jobs.title: Inventory Assistant Manager
jobs.description: Responsible for managing and supervising property unit inventory, ensuring complete access and keys, data accuracy, and smooth operations of goods in all warehouse units managed by Travelio. Job Descriptions: 1. Inventory Management: Input & update access key, linen and towel inventory data in the system. Ensure the condition and availability of goods according to standards. 2. Operational Coordination: Coordinate with operational teams (Housekeeping, Customer Service, Engineering, and QA) for procurement, replacement, and reporting of SK, access and keys. 3. Stock Monitoring: Control consumables (amenities, linen, and others). Make procurement and restocking requests as needed. 4. Reporting & Documentation: Prepare regular inventory reports (weekly/monthly). Documentation of incoming/outgoing goods and supporting administrative archives, both withdrawals from the system or manually. 5. Stock Audit: Carry out stock taking and support the periodic inventory audit process. Requirements: Possess at least a Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business or equivalent. At least 5 years of working experience in the fields of Procurement and Warehouse management at an Hospitality / Real Estate company is required for the position, 5 of which in a Supervisory position. Attention to details and accuracy, having a strong understanding in inventory and demand management. Strong analytical, planning, negotiating, and problem solving skill. Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, to convey complex information in a clear manner to team members and other stakeholders. Willing to work in mobile and shifting schedule.

jobs.title: Teknisi Mobil Makasar
jobs.description: Job description Kesempatan Kami mencari Teknisi Mobil yang terampil dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim teknis kami di CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama. Sebagai Teknisi Mobil, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memastikan kualitas dan keamanan komponen rem kendaraan melalui proses perbaikan dan permesinan yang presisi. Posisi ini merupakan posisi tetap penuh waktu yang memerlukan keahlian teknis tinggi, perhatian terhadap detail, dan komitmen terhadap standar kualitas industri otomotif. Anda akan bekerja langsung untuk memberikan layanan perbaikan dan permesinan yang superior kepada klien kami. Tanggung Jawab Melakukan pemeriksaan, perawatan, dan perbaikan kendaraan. Mendiagnosis kerusakan dan menentukan tindakan perbaikan yang tepat. Melakukan servis berkala dan perbaikan komponen kendaraan. Menjaga kualitas hasil pekerjaan serta kebersihan area kerja. Memastikan pekerjaan dilakukan dengan aman dan sesuai prosedur. Kualifikasi usia maximal 35 Tahun Memiliki pengalaman sebagai teknisi/mekanik mobil. Memahami sistem mesin, kaki-kaki, rem, dan kelistrikan mobil. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki etos kerja yang baik. Memiliki pengalaman spooring & balancing, bubut disk brake, dan servis AC mobil akan menjadi nilai plus. Bersedia bekerja sesuai jam operasional bengkel. Benefit Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dan insentif pekerjaan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kualifikasi Anda. Kesempatan pengembangan keterampilan melalui pelatihan teknis dan sertifikasi industri. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan budaya kerja yang mengedepankan keselamatan. Kesempatan untuk berkembang karier dalam industri otomotif yang dinamis. Tentang Kami CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama adalah perusahaan yang berspesialisasi dalam layanan teknis dan perbaikan komponen otomotif berkualitas tinggi. Dengan komitmen terhadap keunggulan dan inovasi, kami melayani industri otomotif dengan solusi pemesinan. Perusahaan kami dibangun atas fondasi integritas, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya pada pengembangan talenta lokal dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman, inklusif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional setiap anggota tim. Bergabung dengan kami berarti menjadi bagian dari organisasi yang menghargai keahlian teknis, dedikasi, dan kontribusi nyata terhadap kesuksesan industri otomotif Indonesia. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki keahlian yang sesuai dan tertarik dengan kesempatan ini, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio atau sertifikasi teknis Anda kepada tim rekrutmen kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut!

jobs.title: Lighting Specifier
jobs.description: Job Description Melakukan perhitungan DIALux dan simulasi tata cahaya serta memastikan spesifikasi pencahayaan memenuhi standar iluminasi (Lux) yang diwajibkan. Menyiapkan dan menganalisis Bill of Quantities (BoQ) atau gambar kerja dari konsultan/klien untuk melakukan cross-reference produk. Menyiapkan dokumen kebutuhan proyek secara komprehensif, meliputi datasheet, sertifikasi produk, dan data fotometri IES Files. Memberikan dukungan teknis kepada tim Project Sales serta mendampingi presentasi teknis kepada konsultan MEP, arsitek, maupun desainer interior. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Arsitektur, Desain Interior, Teknik Elektro , atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman kerja Minial 2 tahun di bidang Lighting / Project . Menguasai DIALux / DIALux Evo . Menguasai AutoCAD 2D , khususnya untuk plotting titik lampu dan membaca denah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi teknis yang baik. Memiliki sikap kerja proaktif, teliti, dan detail-oriented . Bersedia ditempatkan di Head Office, Cempaka Putih, Jakarta Pusat

jobs.title: DIGITAL BUSINESS ANALYST
jobs.description: Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), Science & Technology, or a related field. Have knowledge and understanding of the financial services industry, particularly Banking, Insurance, and Multifinance. Experience working in the insurance industry will be a strong advantage. Understand how to create and develop business flows for digital products, such as mobile applications, e-commerce platforms, and other digital solutions. Experienced in creating structured and comprehensive documentation, such as Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and other related documents.Pay attention to details Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate and well-structured documentation. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams (e.g., programmers/developers) and customers. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Demonstrate a customer-oriented mindset and the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into business or functional requirements. jobs.title: Teknisi Mobil Banjarmasin Kalimantan Selatan
jobs.description: Job description Kesempatan Kami mencari Teknisi Mobil yang terampil dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim teknis kami di CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama. Sebagai Teknisi Mobil, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memastikan kualitas dan keamanan komponen rem kendaraan melalui proses perbaikan dan permesinan yang presisi. Posisi ini merupakan posisi tetap penuh waktu yang memerlukan keahlian teknis tinggi, perhatian terhadap detail, dan komitmen terhadap standar kualitas industri otomotif. Anda akan bekerja langsung untuk memberikan layanan perbaikan dan permesinan yang superior kepada klien kami. Tanggung Jawab Melakukan pemeriksaan, perawatan, dan perbaikan kendaraan. Mendiagnosis kerusakan dan menentukan tindakan perbaikan yang tepat. Melakukan servis berkala dan perbaikan komponen kendaraan. Menjaga kualitas hasil pekerjaan serta kebersihan area kerja. Memastikan pekerjaan dilakukan dengan aman dan sesuai prosedur. Kualifikasi usia maximal 35 Tahun Memiliki pengalaman sebagai teknisi/mekanik mobil. Memahami sistem mesin, kaki-kaki, rem, dan kelistrikan mobil. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki etos kerja yang baik. Memiliki pengalaman spooring & balancing, bubut disk brake, dan servis AC mobil akan menjadi nilai plus. Bersedia bekerja sesuai jam operasional bengkel. Benefit Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dan insentif pekerjaan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kualifikasi Anda. Kesempatan pengembangan keterampilan melalui pelatihan teknis dan sertifikasi industri. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan budaya kerja yang mengedepankan keselamatan. Kesempatan untuk berkembang karier dalam industri otomotif yang dinamis. Tentang Kami CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama adalah perusahaan yang berspesialisasi dalam layanan teknis dan perbaikan komponen otomotif berkualitas tinggi. Dengan komitmen terhadap keunggulan dan inovasi, kami melayani industri otomotif dengan solusi pemesinan. Perusahaan kami dibangun atas fondasi integritas, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya pada pengembangan talenta lokal dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman, inklusif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional setiap anggota tim. Bergabung dengan kami berarti menjadi bagian dari organisasi yang menghargai keahlian teknis, dedikasi, dan kontribusi nyata terhadap kesuksesan industri otomotif Indonesia. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki keahlian yang sesuai dan tertarik dengan kesempatan ini, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio atau sertifikasi teknis Anda kepada tim rekrutmen kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut!

Job description

Kesempatan
Kami mencari Teknisi Mobil yang terampil dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim teknis kami di CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama. Sebagai Teknisi Mobil, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memastikan kualitas dan keamanan komponen rem kendaraan melalui proses perbaikan dan permesinan yang presisi. Posisi ini merupakan posisi tetap penuh waktu yang memerlukan keahlian teknis tinggi, perhatian terhadap detail, dan komitmen terhadap standar kualitas industri otomotif. Anda akan bekerja langsung untuk memberikan layanan perbaikan dan permesinan yang superior kepada klien kami.

Tanggung Jawab

  • Melakukan pemeriksaan, perawatan, dan perbaikan kendaraan.

  • Mendiagnosis kerusakan dan menentukan tindakan perbaikan yang tepat.

  • Melakukan servis berkala dan perbaikan komponen kendaraan.

  • Menjaga kualitas hasil pekerjaan serta kebersihan area kerja.

  • Memastikan pekerjaan dilakukan dengan aman dan sesuai prosedur.

Kualifikasi

  • usia maximal 35 Tahun

  • Memiliki pengalaman sebagai teknisi/mekanik mobil.

  • Memahami sistem mesin, kaki-kaki, rem, dan kelistrikan mobil.

  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

  • Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki etos kerja yang baik.

  • Memiliki pengalaman spooring & balancing, bubut disk brake, dan servis AC mobil akan menjadi nilai plus.

  • Bersedia bekerja sesuai jam operasional bengkel.

Benefit

  • Gaji pokok yang kompetitif dan insentif pekerjaan sesuai dengan pengalaman serta kualifikasi Anda.

  • Kesempatan pengembangan keterampilan melalui pelatihan teknis dan sertifikasi industri.

  • Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dan budaya kerja yang mengedepankan keselamatan.

  • Kesempatan untuk berkembang karier dalam industri otomotif yang dinamis.

Tentang Kami
CV. Bangun Sukses Bersama adalah perusahaan yang berspesialisasi dalam layanan teknis dan perbaikan komponen otomotif berkualitas tinggi. Dengan komitmen terhadap keunggulan dan inovasi, kami melayani industri otomotif dengan solusi pemesinan. Perusahaan kami dibangun atas fondasi integritas, kualitas produk, dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya pada pengembangan talenta lokal dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman, inklusif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional setiap anggota tim. Bergabung dengan kami berarti menjadi bagian dari organisasi yang menghargai keahlian teknis, dedikasi, dan kontribusi nyata terhadap kesuksesan industri otomotif Indonesia.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memiliki keahlian yang sesuai dan tertarik dengan kesempatan ini, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio atau sertifikasi teknis Anda kepada tim rekrutmen kami. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut!

jobs.title: PPIC Staff
jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Membuat dan memonitor planning produksi frozen food sesuai forecast dan kebutuhan operasional. Mengontrol ketersediaan bahan baku, packaging, dan stok barang jadi agar produksi berjalan lancar. Monitoring inventory serta memastikan sistem FIFO/FEFO diterapkan dengan baik. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Production, Warehouse, dan Purchasing terkait jadwal produksi dan kebutuhan material. Melakukan update data produksi, stock, dan material secara berkala. Memastikan proses produksi berjalan sesuai target dan timeline perusahaan. Membuat laporan PPIC untuk kebutuhan monitoring dan evaluasi produksi. Kualifikasi Minimal D3/S1, diutamakan Teknik Industri, Manajemen, atau Teknologi Pangan. Pengalaman sebagai PPIC di manufaktur/FMCG minimal 1 tahun. Memahami production planning, inventory control, dan sistem FIFO/FEFO. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel dan sistem ERP menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, komunikatif, dan mampu bekerja sesuai target.

jobs.title: Villa Operations Manager
jobs.description: About the role We are looking for an experienced Villa Operations Manager to oversee the daily operations of a premium villa property in Bali. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining high service standards, coordinating operational teams, implementing SOPs, and ensuring smooth day-to-day property operations. This is a hands-on role requiring strong leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Key responsibilities Oversee daily villa operations and ensure consistent premium service standards. Coordinate and supervise cross-functional teams, including Housekeeping, Engineering/Maintenance, Front Office/Guest Relations, and Security. Implement, monitor, and regularly update operational procedures and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in the company's Notion knowledge base. Conduct regular staff training on premium hospitality and guest service standards. Monitor stock levels of operational supplies, cleaning products, guest amenities, and other consumables. Organize regular inventory checks and submit purchasing requests in a timely manner. Ensure operational issues and guest-related matters are handled promptly and professionally. Maintain effective communication between operational departments and management. Provide daily operational reports directly to the General Manager. Take a hands-on approach and personally support on-site operations when required. jobs.title: Office Girl
jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Menjaga kebersihan area kantor, termasuk ruang kerja, pantry, toilet, dan area umum lainnya. Menyediakan minuman untuk karyawan dan tamu kantor. Membantu mempersiapkan ruang rapat dan peralatan yang diperlukan. Mengurus pengantaran dokumen, surat, dan paket ke berbagai bagian dalam kantor. Membantu dalam menata atau merapikan barang-barang di area kantor. Menjaga stok perlengkapan kantor seperti alat tulis, sabun, tisu, dan bahan habis pakai lainnya. Membantu tugas-tugas lainnya yang diberikan oleh atasan terkait dengan kebersihan dan kenyamanan kantor. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMP/SMA/sederajat. Pengalaman di posisi yang sama atau sebagai office lebih diutamakan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan sopan. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri dan juga dalam tim. Teliti, jujur, dan memiliki inisiatif yang tinggi. Bersedia bekerja dengan jadwal fleksibel dan dapat diandalkan dalam menjaga kebersihan kantor. Memiliki penampilan rapi dan bersih.

jobs.title: TOUR OPERATION STAFF
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Tour Operation Staff yang berdedikasi dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Travelingeropa Group. Sebagai Tour Operation Staff, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengelola operasional tur dan memastikan pengalaman perjalanan yang luar biasa bagi pelanggan kami. Posisi ini membutuhkan individu yang detail-oriented, dapat bekerja dengan baik di bawah tekanan, dan memiliki passion dalam industri pariwisata. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berbasis di Tangerang, Banten , dengan peluang untuk berkembang dalam industri travel dan tourism yang dinamis. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola dan mengkoordinasikan semua aspek operasional tur, mulai dari pemesanan hingga pelaksanaan di lapangan. Melakukan komunikasi dengan vendor mitra, termasuk hotel, maskapai penerbangan, pemandu wisata lokal, dan penyedia layanan transportasi untuk memastikan semua detail tur berjalan sesuai rencana. Memproses reservasi pelanggan, mengelola dokumentasi perjalanan, dan memastikan semua kebutuhan administratif terpenuhi dengan baik. Memantau jadwal tur, mengidentifikasi masalah potensial, dan memberikan solusi cepat untuk memastikan kepuasan pelanggan. Menyiapkan itinerary lengkap dan materi informatif untuk pelanggan sebelum keberangkatan. Menangani pertanyaan dan keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan responsif. Memperbarui sistem manajemen tur dan memastikan akurasi data operasional. Berkolaborasi dengan tim penjualan dan marketing untuk mengoptimalkan efisiensi operasional dan kepuasan pelanggan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman dalam operasional tur atau posisi terkait di industri travel dan tourism. Pendidikan minimal SMK/SMA, atau Diploma/Sarjana di bidang Pariwisata, Perhotelan, atau bidang terkait sangat diutamakan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris baik lisan maupun tulisan. Keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang excellent untuk menangani multiple tours secara bersamaan. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang destinasi wisata, terutama di Asia Eropa, dan paket tur yang ditawarkan. Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dan dapat bekerja dengan tenang di bawah tekanan. Profisiensi dalam menggunakan sistem booking dan software operasional tur, serta Microsoft Office. Perhatian terhadap detail dan komitmen terhadap kepuasan pelanggan. Kemampuan beradaptasi dan bersikap fleksibel dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan berubah-ubah. Pengalaman dengan vendor management dan negosiasi harga dihargai. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kinerja Anda. Tunjangan kesehatan dan asuransi komprehensif untuk kesejahteraan Anda dan keluarga. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi profesional. Cuti tahunan dan hari libur nasional yang sesuai dengan peraturan perundangan. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan supportive dengan tim yang passionate tentang travel. Diskon khusus untuk paket tur Travelingeropa Group bagi karyawan dan keluarga. Peluang networking dengan profesional industri travel dan tourism. Program kesejahteraan karyawan yang mendukung work-life balance. Tentang Kami Travelingeropa Group adalah perusahaan travel dan tourism terkemuka di Indonesia yang berfokus pada menyediakan pengalaman perjalanan yang tak terlupakan bagi pelanggan. Dengan keahlian dalam mengorganisir paket tur ke berbagai destinasi menarik, terutama ke Eropa dan Asia, kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan terbaik dengan harga yang kompetitif. Kami percaya bahwa setiap perjalanan adalah sebuah petualangan yang berharga, dan misi kami adalah membuat impian perjalanan setiap pelanggan menjadi kenyataan. Dengan tim profesional yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi, Travelingeropa Group terus berinovasi dalam memberikan solusi travel yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan dan preferensi setiap pelanggan. Kami menghargai keberagaman dan inklusi, serta menciptakan budaya kerja yang positif dan mendorong pertumbuhan profesional setiap anggota tim. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kriteria di atas dan tertarik untuk menjadi bagian dari tim Travelingeropa Group, silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV dan surat motivasi Anda. Kami menunggu untuk menemukan talenta terbaik yang siap membuat perbedaan dalam industri travel dan tourism.

Kami percaya bahwa setiap perjalanan adalah sebuah petualangan yang berharga, dan misi kami adalah membuat impian perjalanan setiap pelanggan menjadi kenyataan. Dengan tim profesional yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi, Travelingeropa Group terus berinovasi dalam memberikan solusi travel yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan dan preferensi setiap pelanggan. Kami menghargai keberagaman dan inklusi, serta menciptakan budaya kerja yang positif dan mendorong pertumbuhan profesional setiap anggota tim.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memenuhi kriteria di atas dan tertarik untuk menjadi bagian dari tim Travelingeropa Group, silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV dan surat motivasi Anda. Kami menunggu untuk menemukan talenta terbaik yang siap membuat perbedaan dalam industri travel dan tourism.

jobs.title: Automation Developer
jobs.description: Responsibilities Automated Order Placement: Develop reliable automation programs based on platform interfaces, APIs, page structures, and permitted operational processes using frameworks such as Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. Multi-Account Management: Design and implement systems for account registration, login, session management, task scheduling, and status monitoring to support scalable account operations. Automation Reliability & Risk Management: Develop solutions to maintain stable operations and reduce abnormal account activity while staying within applicable platform rules and policies. Order & Data Management: Store order results, order status, and system error logs in a structured database and provide interfaces for tracking and reconciliation. System Maintenance & Optimization: Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues such as authentication failures, verification challenges, and changes to platform page structures; continuously improve system reliability and success rates. Compliance Management: Monitor changes to platform policies, technical requirements, and risk-control mechanisms and adjust automation strategies accordingly to ensure compliance. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related field. Minimum 2 years of automation development experience , preferably with experience in e-commerce automation, RPA, web automation, or account management systems. Proficient in at least one of Python or JavaScript (Node.js) and familiar with at least one automation framework such as Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. Good understanding of HTTP, cookies/sessions, request authentication/signatures, User-Agent, and other fundamental web technologies. Experience with scalable automation infrastructure, browser automation, session isolation, or behavior simulation is preferred. Strong problem-solving and learning abilities, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex automation issues. Willing to work at Landmark Pluit, North Jakarta, with full WFO. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Southeast Asian e-commerce platforms such as Shopee, Tokopedia, Lazada, or TikTok Shop. Familiarity with the Shopee Open Platform API or official/certified ERP integration solutions. Experience handling platform verification mechanisms such as reCAPTCHA. Familiarity with Linux server deployment, Docker, scheduled tasks, and system/log monitoring.

jobs.title: Cost Controller Staff
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Memantau dan mencatat semua biaya operasional perusahaan secara akurat dan tepat waktu menggunakan sistem akuntansi yang berlaku. Melakukan analisis biaya terperinci untuk mengidentifikasi tren pengeluaran, penyimpangan anggaran, dan peluang penghematan biaya. Menyiapkan laporan biaya bulanan, triwulanan, dan tahunan yang komprehensif untuk manajemen senior dan keperluan audit. Memvalidasi dan merekonsiliasi dokumen biaya, invoice, dan voucher untuk memastikan akurasi dan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan perusahaan. Berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen untuk mengumpulkan data biaya dan memahami driver biaya operasional. Mengembangkan dan memelihara sistem klasifikasi biaya yang terstruktur dan mudah dilacak. Membantu dalam proses perencanaan anggaran dan forecasting biaya untuk periode mendatang. Melakukan audit internal terhadap pengeluaran untuk memastikan kepatuhan terhadap prosedur keuangan dan standar internal. Memberikan rekomendasi berbasis data kepada manajemen untuk meningkatkan efisiensi biaya dan profitabilitas. Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal Diploma atau Sarjana dalam bidang Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman kerja dalam akuntansi biaya, kontrol biaya, atau posisi akuntansi sejenis. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang prinsip-prinsip akuntansi biaya, alokasi biaya, dan analisis varian. Kemampuan menggunakan software akuntansi modern dan MS Excel dengan tingkat lanjut untuk analisis data dan pembuatan laporan. Perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dengan kemampuan untuk mengelola multiple tasks dan memenuhi deadline yang ketat. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tertulis. Keterampilan analitis yang kuat dengan kemampuan untuk menginterpretasi data finansial dan memberikan insight yang bermakna. Integritas profesional yang tinggi dan komitmen terhadap kerahasiaan informasi keuangan. Pengalaman dengan sistem ERP atau software akuntansi terintegrasi dianggap sebagai nilai tambah.

Role Description 1. Import/Export & Regulatory Compliance Manage import/export permits and regulatory approvals for raw materials, samples, reagents, equipment and finished products. Prepare, submit, and monitor SAS applications , import/export permits, SKI BPOM, Karantina, Rekim, B3, Master List, and other required licenses. Liaise with BPOM, Ministry of Health, Customs, and other authorities. Support Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) and regulatory compliance activities. 2. Customs & Trade Compliance Ensure compliance with customs regulations, HS Code classification, and customs valuation requirements. Coordinate customs clearance activities and manage customs-related documentation. Minimum 3 years of experience in import-export operations, customs compliance, logistics, supply chain, or regulatory affairs. Role Purpose

To manage import-export operations, customs compliance, and regulatory licensing activities while ensuring timely material movement, regulatory adherence, and uninterrupted supply chain operations in support of the company's manufacturing and business objectives.


Role Description

1. Import/Export & Regulatory Compliance

  • Manage import/export permits and regulatory approvals for raw materials, samples, reagents, equipment and finished products.

  • Prepare, submit, and monitor SAS applications, import/export permits, SKI BPOM, Karantina, Rekim, B3, Master List, and other required licenses.

  • Liaise with BPOM, Ministry of Health, Customs, and other authorities.

  • Support Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) and regulatory compliance activities.

2. Customs & Trade Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with customs regulations, HS Code classification, and customs valuation requirements.

  • Coordinate customs clearance activities and manage customs-related documentation.

  • Support customs audits and monitor regulatory changes impacting import-export operations


Required

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Trade, Business Administration, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in import-export operations, customs compliance, logistics, supply chain, or regulatory affairs.

  • Hands-on experience in handling import permits, export permits, and regulatory documentation in Indonesia.

  • Experience in managing SKI BPOM, SAS, Quarantine, Rekim, B3 permits, Master List, or similar regulatory processes.

  • Familiarity with HS Code classification, customs valuation, and customs clearance procedures.

  • Good in written and spoken English.


Preferred

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, healthcare, chemical, or highly regulated manufacturing industries.

  • Familiarity with BPOM regulations and pharmaceutical import-export requirements.

  • Knowledge of Material Transfer Agreements (MTA) and international shipment of biological materials.

  • Certification in Supply Chain, Logistics, Customs, International Trade, or related fields is an advantage

jobs.title: Procurement Officer
jobs.company: PT Citarasa Kuliner Indonesia (Cimol Bojot AA)
jobs.description: Melaksanakan proses pengadaan harian perusahaan termasuk pengumpulan permintaan pembelian, permintaan penawaran harga, pemesanan ke pemasok, pemantauan status pembelian dan kedatangan barang, koordinasi dengan warehouse, DPIC, dan produksi, serta pencatatan administrasi pembelian sesuai prosedur, dalam rangka memastikan proses pengadaan berjalan akurat, efisien, dan mendukung kelancaran operasional perusahaan. Kualifikasi : - Pendidikan minimal S1/D3 jurusan Manajemen, Logistik/Rantai Pasok, Teknik Industri, Akuntansi, atau bidang terkait. - Pengalaman kerja minimal 1–2 tahun di posisi Procurement, Purchasing, atau Supply Chain (diutamakan dari industri manufaktur, F&B, atau ritel). - Terbiasa mengelola operasional pengadaan harian dari Purchase Requisition (PR) hingga Purchase Order (PO). - Menguasai proses Request for Quotation (RFQ), negosiasi harga, perbandingan vendor, serta evaluasi syarat pembayaran (payment terms). - Mampu mengoperasikan sistem ERP/Purchasing (seperti SAP, Oracle, atau Odoo) dan mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk pencatatan administrasi. - Memahami alur integrasi kerja antara pengadaan, Warehouse, PPIC, dan tim Produksi. - Memiliki ketelitian tinggi dalam verifikasi dokumen transaksi (invoice, jalan, PO) dan pencatatan arsip pembelian.

Melaksanakan proses pengadaan harian perusahaan termasuk pengumpulan permintaan pembelian, permintaan penawaran harga, pemesanan ke pemasok, pemantauan status pembelian dan kedatangan barang, koordinasi dengan warehouse, DPIC, dan produksi, serta pencatatan administrasi pembelian sesuai prosedur, dalam rangka memastikan proses pengadaan berjalan akurat, efisien, dan mendukung kelancaran operasional perusahaan.

Kualifikasi :

- Pendidikan minimal S1/D3 jurusan Manajemen, Logistik/Rantai Pasok, Teknik Industri, Akuntansi, atau bidang terkait.
- Pengalaman kerja minimal 1–2 tahun di posisi Procurement, Purchasing, atau Supply Chain (diutamakan dari industri manufaktur, F&B, atau ritel).
- Terbiasa mengelola operasional pengadaan harian dari Purchase Requisition (PR) hingga Purchase Order (PO).
- Menguasai proses Request for Quotation (RFQ), negosiasi harga, perbandingan vendor, serta evaluasi syarat pembayaran (payment terms).
- Mampu mengoperasikan sistem ERP/Purchasing (seperti SAP, Oracle, atau Odoo) dan mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk pencatatan administrasi.
- Memahami alur integrasi kerja antara pengadaan, Warehouse, PPIC, dan tim Produksi.
- Memiliki ketelitian tinggi dalam verifikasi dokumen transaksi (invoice, jalan, PO) dan pencatatan arsip pembelian.

jobs.title: Pengasuh Rumah Tangga
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Hongsheng International Trading mencari Pengasuh Rumah Tangga yang profesional, berdedikasi, dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Surabaya, Jawa Timur. Sebagai Pengasuh Rumah Tangga, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kelancaran operasional rumah tangga klien kami. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang dapat diandalkan, terampil dalam berbagai tugas rumah tangga, dan memiliki dedikasi tinggi terhadap kepuasan pelanggan. Ini adalah posisi tetap penuh waktu yang menawarkan stabilitas kerja dan peluang pengembangan profesional dalam industri layanan domestik. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan pembersihan menyeluruh terhadap seluruh area rumah tangga dan kantor, termasuk kamar, dapur, kamar mandi, dan ruang umum lainnya sesuai dengan standar kebersihan yang telah ditetapkan Mengelola tugas-tugas rumah tangga sehari-hari seperti mencuci pakaian, menyetrika, dan merapikan barang-barang pribadi dengan hati-hati dan teliti Mempersiapkan dan memelihara lingkungan kerja yang aman, nyaman, dan terorganisir bagi penghuni rumah Menangani kebutuhan dapur, termasuk persiapan makanan sederhana dan pencucian peralatan dapur sesuai instruksi pemilik rumah Mempertahankan standar kebersihan dan sanitasi tertinggi di semua area rumah tangga Melaporkan segala kerusakan atau masalah yang memerlukan perbaikan kepada pimpinan Berinteraksi dengan profesional dan terhormat kepada seluruh anggota keluarga dan pengunjung rumah Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMP/SMA atau sederajat Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Pengasuh Rumah Tangga atau dalam posisi layanan domestik yang serupa, Eks TKI lebih disukai Pengetahuan mendalam tentang teknik pembersihan yang efektif dan penggunaan produk pembersih yang aman Keterampilan dalam mengelola tugas-tugas rumah tangga seperti mencuci, menyetrika, dan memasak makanan sederhana Kepribadian yang ramah, jujur, dan dapat dipercaya dengan integritas moral yang tinggi Kemampuan untuk bekerja secara independen dan mengikuti instruksi dengan detail yang tepat Fisik yang sehat dan mampu melakukan pekerjaan fisik secara konsisten Komunikasi yang baik dalam bahasa mandarin sederhana lebih di utamakan Referensi dari pekerjaan sebelumnya akan menjadi nilai tambah Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif dan sesuai dengan standar industri layanan domestik Lingkungan kerja yang aman, profesional, dan menghormati martabat kerja Peluang pengembangan keterampilan melalui pelatihan berkelanjutan Dukungan manajemen yang responsif terhadap kebutuhan dan permasalahan Anda Tentang Kami PT Hongsheng International Trading adalah perusahaan terpercaya yang bergerak di industri layanan profesional dan perdagangan internasional. Kami berkomitmen untuk menyediakan layanan berkualitas tinggi dengan standar profesionalisme yang tinggi kepada klien kami di seluruh Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun dalam industri ini, kami membangun reputasi sebagai mitra yang dapat diandalkan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan layanan domestik dan bisnis. Kami menghargai setiap anggota tim dan percaya bahwa karyawan yang profesional, terlatih, dan termotivasi adalah kunci kesuksesan kami. PT Hongsheng International Trading menciptakan budaya kerja yang inklusif, menghormati, dan mendukung perkembangan karir setiap individu. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan pelatihan, arahan, dan dukungan yang diperlukan agar setiap karyawan dapat memberikan yang terbaik dalam pekerjaan mereka. Cara Melamar Jika Anda merasa memenuhi kualifikasi dan tertarik dengan posisi ini, silakan lamar sekarang dengan mengirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan referensi kerja Anda kepada tim rekrutmen kami. Kami menantikan kesempatan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan mempertimbangkan Anda sebagai bagian dari tim PT Hongsheng International Trading.

jobs.title: Staff Operating Lease
jobs.description: Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal S1 Memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang operating lease, fleet management pada perusahaan pembiayaan Memahami proses operasional operating lease, seperti pengelolaan unit kendaraan, kontrak sewa, serah terima kendaraan, perpanjangan kontrak, maintenance, dan pengembalian unit. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, khususnya Microsoft Excel. Memiliki SIM A yang masih aktif dan mampu mengemudikan mobil dengan baik. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan pihak eksternal maupun pihak internal perusahaan. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, disiplin, dan memiliki attention to detail yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Job Description : Melakukan administrasi dan monitoring operasional kendaraan yang disewakan kepada customer. Memastikan proses serah terima dan pengembalian kendaraan berjalan sesuai prosedur. Melakukan koordinasi dengan customer terkait kebutuhan operasional kendaraan selama periode sewa. Melakukan monitoring kondisi kendaraan, termasuk jadwal service, maintenance, perbaikan, dan kelengkapan dokumen kendaraan. Berkoordinasi dengan bengkel, vendor, driver, customer, dan pihak internal terkait kebutuhan maintenance atau permasalahan kendaraan. Menangani administrasi terkait biaya maintenance, perbaikan, denda, maupun biaya operasional kendaraan sesuai ketentuan perusahaan. Melakukan pekerjaan operasional lainnya yang berkaitan dengan pengelolaan kendaraan operating lease/rental sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.

About the role

PT. Benara Pelita Nusantara is seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated English Tutor to join our education team in North Malinau, North Kalimantan. This is a contract position that offers you the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students' English language development in a growing region. You will be responsible for delivering engaging and effective English language instruction to learners of varying proficiency levels, helping them build confidence and competence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing. This role is essential to our mission of providing quality English education and supporting learners in achieving their academic and personal language goals.

Key responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver engaging English language lessons tailored to students' individual learning needs and proficiency levels

  • Create and prepare high-quality teaching materials, resources, and lesson plans that align with curriculum objectives

  • Assess student progress through regular evaluations, quizzes, and examinations to identify areas for improvement

  • Provide constructive feedback to students to support their language development and learning outcomes

  • Foster a positive and inclusive classroom environment that encourages participation, confidence, and a genuine interest in learning English

  • Communicate regularly with students and parents regarding academic progress and areas requiring additional support

  • Develop and implement strategies to help struggling learners overcome language barriers

  • Participate in professional development activities and training to enhance teaching methodologies

  • Collaborate with colleagues to share best practices and contribute to the overall effectiveness of the tutoring programme


What we're looking for

  • Fluent English language proficiency with near-native or native-level speaking and writing ability

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Education, Linguistics, or a related discipline

  • Teaching qualification or certification such as TEFL, TESOL, or CELTA (or equivalent recognised certification)

  • Minimum 2 years of professional English tutoring or teaching experience in a classroom or tutoring environment

  • Strong knowledge of English grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and comprehension techniques

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with diverse learners

  • Patience, adaptability, and a student-centred teaching approach that accommodates different learning styles

  • Ability to create engaging, interactive lessons using a variety of teaching methods and materials

  • Proficiency in classroom management and maintaining discipline whilst fostering a supportive learning atmosphere

  • Preferably, experience working with learners in Southeast Asian contexts or developing education markets

  • Willingness to work in a remote location and commitment to contributing to educational development in the region


What we offer

PT. Benara Pelita Nusantara is committed to supporting the professional growth and wellbeing of our team members. We offer competitive remuneration for contract staff, professional development opportunities to enhance your teaching skills and qualifications, a collaborative and supportive working environment with experienced colleagues, and the meaningful experience of making a real difference in students' educational journeys. We value your contribution to our mission and are dedicated to providing a positive workplace culture where your expertise is recognised and appreciated.

About us

PT. Benara Pelita Nusantara is an education and training organisation committed to delivering quality learning experiences to communities across Indonesia. Based in North Kalimantan, we are dedicated to providing accessible, high-quality English language education that empowers learners to succeed in an increasingly globalised world. Our mission is to develop confident, competent English speakers who can communicate effectively and pursue their academic, professional, and personal aspirations. We work with passion and commitment to support educational development in the regions we serve.

Apply now

If you are passionate about teaching English and eager to contribute to educational excellence in North Kalimantan, we invite you to submit your application. Please send your CV, cover letter, copies of relevant qualifications and certifications, and examples of your teaching materials to PT. Benara Pelita Nusantara. We look forward to hearing from you and welcome the opportunity to discuss how you can contribute to our team.

jobs.title: Warehouse Coordinator
jobs.description: Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Warehouse Management, or a related field. Minimum 3–7 years of warehouse experience, with at least 2–3 years in a Warehouse Manager, Assistant Manager, or Senior Supervisor role. Experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred, especially in managing raw materials, finished goods, and production-related warehouse operations. Strong knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms. Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with inventory control, FIFO/FEFO, cycle counting, stock reconciliation, warehouse layout, and 5S. Ability to manage manpower, warehouse capacity, operational costs, and multiple priorities under pressure. Proficiency in Mandarin is a plus. Responsibilities : Plan, organize, and oversee daily warehouse operations (Ensure proper storage of raw materials, finished goods, spare parts, and other warehouse items according to company standards). Classify and organize SKUs based on product type, characteristics, movement, storage requirements, and inventory turnover to optimize warehouse space and operational efficiency. Train, coach, and evaluate warehouse personnel to improve productivity and work quality Ensure inventory accuracy through regular stock counting, reconciliation, and investigation of discrepancies. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, 5S standards, and warehouse procedures. Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, damaged goods, and warehouse-related issues. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly warehouse reports, including inventory status and operational performance.

Fluent Mandarin and native Indonesian, with the ability to communicate effectively with Chinese management. Strong knowledge of Indonesian labor laws and regulations. Willing to work in Landmark Pluit, North Jakarta

jobs.title: Senior Customs Clearence Specialist
jobs.description: Senior Customs Clearance Specialist Join Rise Again Logistic Indonesia as our Senior Customs Clearance Specialist and become a key contributor to our international freight forwarding operations. Candidates must hold a valid Customs Certificate / PPJK certification and have hands-on experience handling customs clearance processes. Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end import/export customs clearance , including independently preparing and submitting PIB/PEB via CEISA 4.0 . Verify HS Codes, customs valuation, duties/taxes, Lartas , and regulatory requirements. Manage and review commercial invoices, packing lists, BL/AWB, COO, permits, quarantine, and other supporting documents . Coordinate customs inspections and clearance procedures with Customs, government agencies, terminals, airlines/shipping lines, warehouses, trucking, agents, customers, and internal teams. Ensure customs compliance , identify risks, and take corrective actions. Stay updated on customs regulations, CEISA procedures, and import/export requirements . International air freight forwarding experience strongly preferred. Key Requirements Candidates must hold a valid Customs Expert / PPJK certification and have hands-on experience handling customs clearance processes, candidates without this certification will not be considered. Proficient in English both oral and written are mandatory . jobs.title: Darkstore Staff
jobs.description: About the Role Blibli is transforming into a future-ready digital ecosystem where speed, accuracy, and operational excellence are at the core of every customer experience. Our Dark Stores play a vital role in ensuring products are available and delivered efficiently to support our omnichannel business. As a Dark Store / Warehouse Specialist, you will oversee day-to-day warehouse operations, ensuring smooth inbound, processing, inventory management, and replenishment activities. You will lead frontline teams, maintain inventory accuracy, and drive operational excellence by ensuring compliance with SOPs, productivity targets, and service levels.This role is ideal for someone with strong operational leadership, warehouse experience, and a passion for building high-performing teams. What You'll Do Supervise daily dark store operations, including inbound, processing, inventory control, and replenishment activities. Ensure inventory accuracy through effective stock monitoring, reconciliation, and movement control. Monitor operational productivity and ensure compliance with SOPs, quality, and safety standards. Lead, coach, and manage warehouse associates and vendor manpower to achieve operational targets. Coordinate with Supply Chain, Inventory Planning, and Logistics teams to ensure seamless operations. Identify operational issues and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency. Prepare operational reports and monitor key performance indicators to support business decisions. Ensure timely replenishment and product availability to support downstream distribution and customer demand. What You'll Bring to the Team Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in any discipline. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in warehouse, distribution center, or dark store operations. Experience in handling fresh/frozen items will be a strong plus. Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory control, and replenishment processes. Experience leading operational teams and managing vendor manpower. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Microsoft Office is an advantage. Able to work in a fast-paced operational environment and adapt to shifting business priorities. Why You'll Love Working Here We believe operational excellence starts with great leadership. At Blibli, you'll lead teams that keep our operations running efficiently while creating better experiences for customers every day. Join us and play a key role in strengthening our omnichannel operations as we continue growth — transforming together.
